patches.title: [November 11] SkyBlock Patch Notes
patches.summary: High-ping mining improvements: leftover break time now carries over to the next block, and partial progress is kept when you look away. Hard Stone can now be mined client-side.

itemNotes.HARD_STONE: Can now be mined client-side (no ping delay) in the Crystal Hollows, so Hard Stone mining rates go up slightly.

patches.title: [October 28] SkyBlock Patch Notes
patches.summary: Small fixes round-up: Vargul accepts a Bachelor's Rose, Cheesebites cost 160k coins to analyze, and several item interactions were fixed (Fiesta Flask in potion bags, Melon Juice Mixin, Black Hole crafting).

itemNotes.CHEESEBITE: Analyzing a Cheesebite now costs 160,000 coins.

itemNotes.BACHELOR_ROSE: Now required to recruit SPECIAL visitors (Spaceman, Taylor) once you meet their requirement, so more demand.

patches.title: [October 15] SkyBlock Patch Notes
patches.summary: Bug fixes: powder no longer resets at the 2 billion cap, plus fixes for fusion requirements, Greenhouse Moonflowers and the Trick or Treat Bag.

patches.title: [October 14] SkyBlock Patch Notes
patches.summary: Doubled Glossy Gemstone and Refined Mineral drop rates at every Breaking Power, and the Fiesta Flask now boosts both drops and doubles the Scatha and Stoneworm shard effects. The Great Spook runs until November 2.

itemNotes.REFINED_MINERAL: Drop rate doubled at every Breaking Power (BP1 0.01% -> 0.02% up to BP9 0.09% -> 0.18%), and an active Fiesta Flask adds +100% more. Expect more supply.

itemNotes.SHARD_STONEWORM: Its effect is doubled while a Fiesta Flask is active.

patches.title: [October 13] SkyBlock Patch Notes
patches.summary: Greenhouse and combat fixes, including Plant Yield no longer wrongly boosting mutation items and Ethereal Vine drops. Several Fishing XP sources were corrected.

itemNotes.ETHEREAL_VINE: Bug fix: Plant Yield bonuses were wrongly increasing Ethereal Vine drops; that extra supply is gone.
itemNotes.GLOSSY_GEMSTONE: Developers said drop rates were lower than intended and promised a fix (the buff landed the next day).

patches.title: Hypixel SkyBlock 0.27.2 - The Minister Update, Greenhouse QOL, and More!
patches.summary: 0.27.2: adds all the Minister perks (Precursor Drone mods, a year-long Mining Fiesta with Fiesta Flasks, bait sacks, loadouts, weather and more), Greenhouse decay/watering QOL and reworked mob levels for slayers. Advanced reforge costs now scale with the reforge stone's rarity.

itemNotes.ESSENCE_FOREST: New sink: the Forest Essence shop sells Drone Mod: Grungle for 2,500 essence.
itemNotes.HARDENED_WOOD: This reforge stone gets a new 'Stiff Bonus'. Applying advanced reforges now costs a fixed amount based on the stone's rarity.

patches.title: [October 5] SkyBlock Patch Notes
patches.summary: Fixed mushrooms spreading across the whole Garden, fixed island sky colors, and made switching between SkyBlock servers slightly faster.

patches.title: [September 29] SkyBlock Patch Notes
patches.summary: Fixed the Lotus Atoll Chapter V collection task and two Tiger pet / Fatal Tempo ferocity bugs.

patches.title: Taylor's Autumn 2026 Bundle

patches.title: [September 17] SkyBlock Patch Notes

patches.title: Hypixel SkyBlock 0.27.1 - Chocolate Factory Improvements, QOL Changes, and more!

patches.title: [August 27] SkyBlock Patch Notes

patches.title: [August 24] SkyBlock Patch Notes

patches.title: [August 19] SkyBlock Patch Notes
patches.summary: Hunting XP rework: the Critter Safari becomes the main Hunting XP source (new Uniqueness Score and bigger floor-drop XP), while XP from the Fusion Machine, Ghosts and Glacite Walkers was cut.

patches.title: [August 11] SkyBlock Patch Notes 2

itemNotes.SHARD_POWER_DRAGON: Can no longer be made through ID fusion. Still obtainable from M7, or from Hellwisp with a Chameleon shard, so supply drops.

patches.title: [August 11] SkyBlock Patch Notes
patches.summary: Large 0.27 adjustment patch: Signal Enhancers added to the Bazaar, the Karma enchantment drop chance raised tenfold, and Ruby Veilshroom yields increased. Plus many Critter Safari, bestiary and booster changes.

itemNotes.ENCHANTMENT_KARMA_*: Drop chance raised from 0.02% to 0.2% (10x), so much more supply.
itemNotes.RUBY_VEILSHROOM: Base yield 1 -> 4-8, more from Torrhus sea creatures, and the Accretion Artifact now needs 2 instead of 16. More supply, less demand.

patches.title: [August 6] 0.27 Hotfixes & Healing Revamp Adjustments
patches.summary: 0.27 hotfixes and Healing Revamp tweaks: fixed Mastiff Armor's heal and swapped its debuff for a Defense-based crit bonus, nerfed Enderman Slayer and Wither Miner damage, and reverted the Refrigerate cost to Volcanic Rock plus North Shards.

itemNotes.SPOTLITE: Fixed Discrite not evolving into Spotlite after 150 hours.

patches.title: [August 5] SkyBlock Patch Notes #2
patches.summary: Bug fixes for potion effects, the Daily Wishes perk and the Critter Safari. Some glitched blocks from newer Minecraft versions were removed from the game because of exploits.

patches.title: [August 5] SkyBlock Patch Notes
patches.summary: Hotfixes for the 0.27 release: Torrhus Canyon access checks, Helix Logs counting for Absorb, Lushlilac Bonbon chapter tasks and pest pathfinding.

patches.title: Hypixel SkyBlock 0.27 - Torrhus Canyon & Critter Safari
patches.summary: 0.27: adds Torrhus Canyon, the second Foraging island (Heart of the Forest tier 8, new Helix Log, Ruby Veilshroom and Honeycomb collections), and the Critter Safari with about 150 new attributes. The Hunting skill cap rises to 50, and many bestiaries were reduced.

itemNotes.ENCHANTED_MANGROVE_LOG: Rarity lowered from Rare to Uncommon.

itemNotes.MANGROVE_LOG: NPC sell price raised from 8 to 14.

patches.title: [July 23] Healing Revamp Hotfixes
patches.summary: Healing Revamp hotfixes: Berserk heals on hit again, slayer and Dungeon damage values were corrected, and Tarantula Slayer damage was lowered.

patches.title: Hypixel SkyBlock 0.26.1 - New Player Improvements, Harvest Feast Changes, Healing Revamp, and more!
patches.summary: 0.26.1: new-player improvements (Beginner Sacks, a unified farming armor path, buffed starter tools), new Harvest Feast items, and the Healing Revamp, which turns Vitality into a resource that healing abilities spend. Mob damage was lowered across the game to compensate.

itemNotes.THORN_FRAGMENT: Used to craft the new Blooming Thorns reforge stone.

patches.title: [July 13] SkyBlock Patch Notes
patches.summary: Added 4 more Stat Tuning slots, the missing 15th Chocolate Egg on the Lotus Atoll, and a few small fixes.

patches.summary: 0.26: launches the official SkyBlock Resource Pack, Loadouts (gear and HOTM/HOTF presets), an Equipment Wardrobe and a Security Quest. Drops support for Minecraft 1.21.9 and 1.21.10.

patches.title: [July 4] SkyBlock Patch Notes
patches.summary: Fixed some Legendary sea creatures ignoring the Tracking stat.

patches.summary: Removed Grand Feast from Jerry's Perkpocalypse, fixed pearl teleports at corners, and made many bugged collectible items Co-op Soulbound so they can't be traded.

patches.title: SkyBlock's 7th Anniversary + SkyBlock Resource Pack News!

patches.title: Hypixel SkyBlock 0.24.1 - Swappable Pet Items, Garden Changes, & Bug Fixes
patches.summary: Pet items can now be swapped for 25k-2.5M coins depending on rarity (the Super Scrubber removes one). Sunflower Oil and Bachelor's Rose join the Bazaar.

itemNotes.BACHELOR_ROSE: Added to the Bazaar in this patch.
itemNotes.ENCHANTED_COOKIE: Gained a shapeless crafting recipe, which makes it easier to craft.
itemNotes.SUNFLOWER_OIL: Added to the Bazaar in this patch.

patches.title: [January 22] SkyBlock Patch Notes
patches.summary: Raises the minimum bids for most Dark Auction products to curb collusion, runs about three times as many Dark Auction worlds per cycle, and changes Beth's Garden rewards.

patches.title: [January 20] SkyBlock 0.24.1 Release Candidate
patches.summary: Release candidate for 0.24.1 that brings swappable pet items with coin costs by rarity, a large batch of bugfixes, and Sunflower Oil and Bachelor's Rose on the Bazaar.

itemNotes.BACHELOR_ROSE: Added to the Bazaar in this patch.
itemNotes.ENCHANTED_COOKIE: Gained a shapeless crafting recipe, which makes it easier to craft.
itemNotes.SUNFLOWER_OIL: Added to the Bazaar in this patch.

patches.title: Dark Auction Server Patch
patches.summary: Reduces Dark Auction server size from 20 to 12 players and lowers the minimum player count from 10 to 5, aiming to reduce overbidding.

patches.title: [January 13] SkyBlock Patch Notes
patches.summary: Fixes Greenhouse offline growth, Moonflower greenhouse effects, and melon and pumpkin stem growth in The Garden. Also rebalances Farming XP from Greenhouse harvesting.

patches.title: [Jan 12] SkyBlock Patch Notes
patches.summary: Removes the Soul Eater damage cap in Dungeons, lowers the Burning Vengeance damage cap to 25M, and re-enables cocooning. Also fixes several legacy reforge and pet bugs.

patches.title: Taylor's Winter 2025 Bundle
patches.summary: Releases Taylor's Winter 2025 Bundle with 10 new cosmetics, available from December 20 to March 21, and notes that seasonal bundles will return from this winter.

patches.title: [December 18] SkyBlock Patch Notes
patches.summary: Reduces Greenhouse crop drops and cuts Gloomgourd mutation drops by 65%. Doubles the Rosewater Flask recipe cost and adds a 2-hour co-op cooldown, along with Jacob's Contest and Gemstone Grinder fixes.

itemNotes.CARROT_ITEM: Base Greenhouse crop drops reduced, so expect less supply.
itemNotes.COMPACTED_WILD_ROSE: Rosewater Flask recipe now costs 32 instead of 16, raising demand for this item.
itemNotes.GLOOMGOURD: Crop drops from the mutation reduced by 65%, so expect much less supply.

patches.title: [December 16] SkyBlock Patch Notes
patches.summary: Fixes the Greenhouse tutorial trigger and some item text typos (Godseed, Thunderling, tutorial Garden Chip), and SkyMart now explains Hydrocan requirements.

patches.title: Hypixel SkyBlock 0.24 - The Greenhouse
patches.summary: Adds the Greenhouse, a Garden plot where crops keep growing while you are offline, along with a mutation system and crop effects. Sunflower, Moonflower and Wild Rose become farmable custom crops, Farming Tools are revamped, and crop milestones are cut by 68%.

itemNotes.CROPIE: Farming armors can now drop Cropie from crops harvested in the Greenhouse. Cropie Armor gives 12.5% bonus pest chance.
itemNotes.DOUBLE_PLANT: Sunflower is no longer part of the Flower Minion, and it is now required for Jacob's Contest Completionist emblems.
itemNotes.ENCHANTED_GOLDEN_CARROT: Recipe now requires 160x of the previous tier.
itemNotes.FERMENTO: Farming armors can now drop Fermento from crops harvested in the Greenhouse. Fermento is also added to the Garden Sack.
itemNotes.MOONFLOWER: Now a custom Garden crop that can be grown in the Greenhouse or farmed elsewhere. Required for Jacob's Contest Completionist emblems, which adds demand.
itemNotes.SQUASH: Farming armors can now drop Squash from crops harvested in the Greenhouse. Squash Armor gives 15% bonus pest chance.
itemNotes.WARTY: Wart Eater drop chance raised from 0.01-0.05% to 0.02-0.1%. Warty now counts as a rare crop, so Rarefinder and the Rose Dragon pet affect it.
itemNotes.WILD_ROSE: Now a custom Garden crop that can be grown in the Greenhouse or farmed elsewhere. Required for Jacob's Contest Completionist emblems, which adds demand.

patches.title: [December 15] SkyBlock Patch Notes
patches.summary: Hotfix for the 0.24 Greenhouse release. It fixes a refund bug for new Garden profiles, placement of the new crops, and several NPC sell prices. Jacob's Contest rewards and a Carpenter blueprint bug are still being worked on.

itemNotes.ENCHANTED_COOKIE: Wheat removed from the recipe, and the NPC sell price was corrected.

patches.title: [November 9th] SkyBlock Patch Notes
patches.summary: Lists Mythos Fragments on the Bazaar under Oddities and raises their weight from Griffin Burrows dug with both the Archaic and Deific Spades.

patches.title: [November 5] SkyBlock Patch Notes
patches.summary: Fixes Dungeon Chest Bingo tasks that could not be completed, Griffin Upgrade Stones that would not stack, and inconsistent Kuudra Shard amounts. Also stops Crown of Avarice from gaining coins off non-Mythos mobs.

patches.title: Hypixel SkyBlock 0.23.6 - Mythological Ritual v2 & Vesuvius

itemNotes.GRIFFIN_UPGRADE_STONE_UNCOMMON: Now on the Bazaar, with its recipe updated for the new Ritual drops.

patches.title: [October 16] 0.23.5 Bug Fixes + Changes

patches.title: Hypixel SkyBlock 0.23.4 - Primordial Broodfather Changes, Abiphone Keynote Event, and more!
patches.summary: Continues the Primordial Broodfather rework with RNG Meter support, catalyst drop changes and a Spider Slayer boss tweak. Also overhauls the stats menu into categories, adds a /reclaim command for old items, and adds /call for Abiphone contacts.

itemNotes.SPIDER_CATALYST: Added to the Tier II Broodfather loot table at weight 125.
itemNotes.SUSPICIOUS_SCRAP: Cap removed on how many can drop in a Glacite Mineshaft. Each drop still halves the chance of the next one.
itemNotes.TARANTULA_CATALYST: Can now drop at Spider Slayer 4 (was 5). Mosquito Shortbow recipe now uses 2x Tarantula Catalyst in place of 128x Enchanted Emerald.

patches.title: [August 19] SkyBlock Patch Notes
patches.summary: Fixes Rift Crux mobs floating away and not respawning, overly strong Scarecrows, and Spooky Festival mobs not spawning after restarts. Abyssal armor now counts for Eleanor's quest.

patches.title: [August 14] SkyBlock Patch Notes
patches.summary: Small patch after 0.23.3 that changes the mob types of many mobs, removes the Sharpness conflict with mob-specific enchantments, and removes the need to move while fishing. Also retunes Agatha and Starlyn contest point values.

patches.title: Hypixel SkyBlock 0.23.3 - Foraging Changes, Mob Types, and more!
patches.summary: A Foraging overhaul with new Museum items, achievements and Agatha brackets. Adds a Mob Types system with enchantment interactions, a Bogged sea creature in Galatea, Booster changes, and shard fusion and drop changes.

itemNotes.ESSENCE_FOREST: Catacombs level requirement removed for buying it on the Bazaar. Sweep and Foraging Wisdom boosters now salvage for 5 Forest Essence.
itemNotes.FORAGING_WISDOM_BOOSTER: Fig Tree Gift chance cut from 0.5% to 0.3%, Mangrove from 0.8% to 0.5%. Now sellable on the Bazaar and stackable.
itemNotes.SEA_LUMIES: Abysmal Lasso can now also be crafted with 5x Sea Lumies.
itemNotes.SHARD_APEX_DRAGON: Guaranteed to appear in Emerald Chests and higher in Master Mode 7.
itemNotes.SHARD_CHAMELEON: Only 1 Shard is now needed to fuse Chameleons.
itemNotes.SHARD_CROPEETLE: Improved fusion recipe: 2x Cropeetle = 5x Termite + 5x Praying Mantis.
itemNotes.SHARD_DAEMON: Fusing into it now yields 2 shards per fusion (was 1), so more supply.
itemNotes.SHARD_FIREFLY: Improved fusion recipe: 2x Firefly = 5x Praying Mantis + 5x fiery mob.
itemNotes.SHARD_KRAKEN: Kuudra now gives 1, 1, 1, 1.25 and 1.5 Kraken Shards for tiers 1-5.
itemNotes.SHARD_LADYBUG: Improved fusion recipe: 2x Ladybug = 5x Termite + 5x Invisibug.
itemNotes.SHARD_NEWT: Used with any Water Shard to fuse Salamanders.
itemNotes.SHARD_POWER_DRAGON: Guaranteed to appear in Emerald Chests and higher in Master Mode 7.
itemNotes.SHARD_PRAYING_MANTIS: Improved fusion recipe: 2x Praying Mantis = 5x Pest + 5x Combat.
itemNotes.SHARD_SALAMANDER: Now fused from a Newt Shard plus any Water Shard.
itemNotes.SHARD_SUN_FISH: Improved fusion recipe: 2x Sun Fish = 5x Shinyfish + 5x Firey Mob.
itemNotes.SHARD_TERMITE: Improved fusion recipe: 2x Termite = 5x Bug + 5x Mining.
itemNotes.SHARD_WARTYBUG: Improved fusion recipe: 2x Wartybug = 5x Dragonfly + 5x Lunar Moth.
itemNotes.STRETCHING_STICKS: Fig Tree Gift drop chance cut from 20% to 10%. Several Huntaxe and Fig recipes now need more sticks.
itemNotes.SWEEP_BOOSTER: Fig Tree Gift chance cut from 1% to 0.5%, Mangrove from 1.5% to 1%. Can now be sold on the Bazaar and sold to NPCs for 25,000 coins.

patches.title: [August 5] SkyBlock Patch Notes
patches.summary: Raises Dark Claymore crit damage from +30% to +100% and gives Tormentor +100% crit damage. Also fixes Smite VII dropping from Zombie Slayer instead of its intended Severed Hand drop.

itemNotes.ENCHANTMENT_SMITE_7: Smite VII no longer drops from Zombie Slayer. It only comes from the Severed Hand, so supply from that source is reduced.
itemNotes.SEVERED_HAND: Now the only intended source of Smite VII, so it matters more for Smite VII supply.

patches.title: [July 28] SkyBlock Patch Notes
patches.summary: Makes the Shriveled Cornea craftable at Spider Slayer 8 and changes Mosquito Pet upgrade costs and Bloodshot. A hotfix then removed Bloodshot from all items and refunded players who had applied it with a Cornea.

itemNotes.ENCHANTED_EYE_OF_ENDER: Used at 64 per Shriveled Cornea, which adds demand for it.
itemNotes.SHRIVELED_CORNEA: New recipe at Spider Slayer 8: 4 Shriveled Wasps + 64 Enchanted Eyes of Ender. A hotfix later stripped Bloodshot from all items and refunded users.
itemNotes.SUPER_EGG: Mosquito Pet crafting now needs 1 Super Enchanted Egg.
itemNotes.TARANTULA_SILK: Mosquito Pet crafting now needs 4 Tarantula Silk. Kat upgrades cost 8x, 16x, 32x and 64x Silk by tier.

patches.title: Regarding Event Rewards and Habanero Tactics
patches.summary: Postpones deletion of unclaimed event rewards by another two weeks, with a chat notice on login for anyone holding unclaimed rewards. Also fixes Habanero Tactics so its Magic Find buff applies to kills.

patches.title: Hypixel SkyBlock 0.23.2 - The Primordial Broodfather
patches.summary: Adds the Primordial Broodfather as a fifth Spider Slayer tier, with new chase items like the Primordial belt and Vial of Venom. Also rebuilds several Spider Slayer items and fixes a damage reduction stacking exploit.

itemNotes.ENCHANTMENT_BANE_OF_ARTHROPODS_7: Every obtainment source was replaced with the Ensnared Snail, so Bane VII now comes from it.
itemNotes.ENSNARED_SNAIL: New endcap item. It replaces all obtainment sources of Bane of Arthropods VII.
itemNotes.TARANTULA_WEB: Fewer Tarantula Webs are needed in the Tarantula Boots recipe.
itemNotes.VIAL_OF_VENOM: New consumable: each use adds +1 Crit Damage, up to 5 uses (+5 total).

patches.title: Hypixel SkyBlock 0.23.1 - Hina's Chapters, Pet Crafting Changes, and more!
patches.summary: Adds Hina's Chapters and removes all randomness from Pet Crafting, so crafted pets start at Common. Also rebalances Husbandry recipes for rabbit hide and leather and adds an Enchanted Cooked Rabbit.

itemNotes.ENCHANTED_COOKED_RABBIT: New item, crafted from 160x Enchanted Raw Rabbit.
itemNotes.ENCHANTED_GLOWSTONE: Drop rate from Fireproof Witches reduced to offset the new Enchanted Glowstone Dust drop.
itemNotes.ENCHANTED_GLOWSTONE_DUST: Now a drop from Fireproof Witches.
itemNotes.ENCHANTED_RABBIT: Used at 160x per Enchanted Cooked Rabbit.
itemNotes.FRIED_FEATHER: NPC sell price reduced to 1,000 coins.
itemNotes.RABBIT: Rabbit Minion recipes now use only Raw Rabbit.
itemNotes.RABBIT_HIDE: Fixed Rabbit Minions dropping only half the Rabbit Hide they should have.

patches.title: [July 2] SkyBlock Patch Notes
patches.summary: Golden and Diamond Goblins return, and several HOTM/HOTF bugs are fixed, including perks unlockable without tokens and pickaxe-ability boosts (Core of the Mountain, Blue Cheese Goblin Omelette) not applying.

patches.title: [July 1] Extreme Bingo & Bug Fixes
patches.summary: Adds the Bingbow and Bingo Rod for Extreme Bingo and turns the Binghoe into an axe model. Also fixes several Foraging and Hunting Toolkit bugs and notes that Dark Auction is currently degraded by server performance problems.

patches.title: Hypixel SkyBlock 0.23 - The Foraging Update
patches.summary: Launches the Foraging Update, with the Park revamp, the Galatea islands and their Foraging collections, and a Hunting skill that turns shards into permanent attributes. Kuudra now yields more Crimson Essence and drops Kraken Shards.

itemNotes.DIVER_FRAGMENT: Emperor's Skull now crafts a new Accessory line, adding a new use for the item.
itemNotes.ESSENCE_CRIMSON: Kuudra gives significantly more Crimson Essence, which should raise its supply.
itemNotes.SHARD_KRAKEN: 1 to 3 Kraken Shards now drop from every Kuudra Paid Chest, based on fight tier, so supply should rise.

patches.title: [April 12] SkyBlock Patch Notes
patches.summary: Minion fixes: Inferno minions now see each other during offline simulation, melons and fire no longer spread inside minions, and minion-boosting crystals reach their full range again.

patches.title: [April 10] SkyBlock Patch Notes
patches.summary: Fixes false 'imperfect layout' warnings on Redstone and Fishing minions, notes that Cactus minions need open air around them, and fixes the April Fools NPC Chuckleton lingering.

patches.title: [April 1st] SkyBlock Patch Notes
patches.summary: Starts the April Fools Honk and Seek event, hiding about a dozen small items around SkyBlock for a week. Drop chances were raised later in the event and a Catgirl skin sale was added.

patches.title: SkyBlock Patch Notes 0.22.1 - General Changes and Bug Fixes
patches.summary: Minor 0.22.1 update that adds Divine Gift II and III to the Bazaar and adds a Garden level requirement to Emissary Sisko. Also includes a batch of Garden, fishing, enchanting, and item fixes.

itemNotes.ENCHANTMENT_DIVINE_GIFT_2: Now sold on the Bazaar, giving players a market source for this book.
itemNotes.ENCHANTMENT_DIVINE_GIFT_3: Now sold on the Bazaar, giving players a market source for this book.

patches.title: [March 19] Backwater Bayou - Day 1 Patch
patches.summary: Day-one fixes for the Backwater Bayou: Alligator becomes Legendary and heavier, Octopus Tendril and Severed Pincer drop rates double, and Hotspot Bait now crafts 32 instead of 16. Can of Worms, Blue Ring, and Moby-Duck: Collector's Edition join the Bazaar.

itemNotes.HOTSPOT_BAIT: Recipe now yields 32 Hotspot Bait per craft instead of 16, which increases supply.
itemNotes.SHARD_ALLIGATOR: Rarity raised from Rare to Legendary and weight from 25 to 50, so it should drop noticeably more often.

patches.title: Hypixel SkyBlock 0.22 - The Backwater Bayou
patches.summary: Launches the Backwater Bayou, the first dedicated fishing island, with rod parts, fishing hotspots, and 14 new sea creatures. Fishing balance changes adjust treasure chances and sea creature stats, and Frost Walker is removed.

itemNotes.ENCHANTMENT_FROST_WALKER_*: Frost Walker is removed from the game, so no new copies of the book will be available.
itemNotes.GOLDEN_BOUNTY: Gains an NPC sell price of 1M coins, setting a price floor for this item.
itemNotes.PESTHUNTING_GUIDE: Gains an NPC sell price of 1M coins, setting a price floor for this item.

patches.title: [February 24] SkyBlock Patch Notes
patches.summary: Quick fixes that disable Berberis Blowgun in the Time Chamber and remove kill credit and drops from Eleanor's 10th mirror mobs. Also sets Tidal's Defense values to 5, 10 and 15 percent.

patches.title: Taylor's Lunar & Valentine Bundles
patches.summary: Adds Lunar New Year and Valentine skin bundles to Taylor's Seasonal Shop. Necron's Ladders and Diana Bookshelves become one-time consumables, and both are now sold on Shen's Auction for 75M.

patches.title: [February 13] SkyBlock Patch Notes
patches.summary: Fishy Treats now fit in the Events Sack, and Tidal grants Defense versus Sea Creatures rather than damage reduction. Also fixes Bouncy Beach Balls and some Treasure Fishing loot.

patches.title: Hypixel SkyBlock 0.21.3 - Year of the Seal
patches.summary: Launches the Year of the Seal yearly event, where Beach Ball fishing earns Fishy Treats, and brings back the Shiny Pig event as the Year of the Pig. Also adds Crystal Hollows, Mines of Divan, and Rift changes.

patches.title: Hypixel SkyBlock 0.21.2 - Year 400 Raffle Event
patches.summary: Reruns the Year 300 raffle as the Year 400 event, with fully randomized minor rewards, new Century Cakes, and a daily cap on raffle tickets from playtime. Also adds eight new raffle items and reworks the Raffle Milestones.

patches.title: [January 28] Reducing NPC Sell Price of Corrupted Fragments
patches.summary: Cuts the NPC sell price of Corrupted Fragments from 20 coins to 1 to curb inflation, which the team says is driven by Slime Minion setups. Also fixes Pest Trap timers and prepares for the Year 400 event.

itemNotes.CORRUPTED_FRAGMENT: NPC sell price cut from 20 coins to 1, which removes a major coin source for Slime Minion setups.

patches.title: [January 23] SkyBlock Patch Notes
patches.summary: Raises the Speckled Teacup's drop weight from 4 to 120 and makes Habanero Tactics V grant 5 Combat Wisdom. Also fixes Experimentation Table RNG Meter progress and dye odds on RNG Meters and boss drops.

patches.title: [January 22] SkyBlock Patch Notes
patches.summary: Hotfix for 0.21.1 that fixes RNG Meter progress, Pest Repellent behavior, and Mithril Grubber's stated powder yield. Also adds Thunderbolt VII to the Bazaar and moves Scavenger from the Ultra Rare pool to the Rare pool.

itemNotes.ENCHANTMENT_SCAVENGER_*: Moved from the Ultra Rare to the Rare RNG Meter pool, so the Experimentation Table should yield it more often.
itemNotes.ENCHANTMENT_THUNDERBOLT_7: Added to the Bazaar after a scaling fix.

patches.title: Hypixel SkyBlock 0.21.1 - Experimentation Table RNG Meter, Abandoned Quarry, and More!
patches.summary: Adds an Experimentation Table RNG Meter, the Abandoned Quarry in the Dwarven Mines, and Pesthunter gear with a Pest Cooldown rework. Radioactive Vial's drop chance is raised and Wriggling Larva gains a 250k NPC sell price.

itemNotes.RADIOACTIVE_VIAL: Drop chance raised from 0.3% to 0.5%, so supply should rise.
itemNotes.WRIGGLING_LARVA: Gains an NPC sell price of 250k coins, setting a price floor for this item.

patches.title: [December 13] Rift Mountaintop Fixes
patches.summary: Adds Highlite to the Bazaar and fixes several Rift softlocks and exploits, including Ubik's Split or Steal minigame and the Wizardman Brawl. Also fixes tablist and Enchanted Clock issues.

itemNotes.HIGHLITE: Now sold on the Bazaar, so it has a market price.

patches.title: Hypixel SkyBlock 0.21 - Rift Mountaintop
patches.summary: Launches The Mountaintop at the end of the Rift, with Timite Ore, the Time Pocket Bag, Puffs, and the Wizardman trials. Glacite Maniacs now always drop an Enchanted Glacite, and a Highlite recipe is added.

itemNotes.ENCHANTED_GLACITE: Glacite Maniacs now always drop 1 Enchanted Glacite on kill, adding a guaranteed supply source.

patches.title: Hypixel SkyBlock 0.20.9 - Crimson Isle QoL
patches.summary: Crimson Isle update that reworks Kuudra armor and Trophy Fishing, making Trophy Fish Chance a stat and raising the cost of Diamond Magmafish. Most Crimson Isle items are no longer soulbound, Kuudra key costs drop, and the Lava Fishing loot pools are rewritten.

itemNotes.LAVA_SHELL: Crimson Isle large treasure pool gives Lava Shell about 14% of rolls, so Lava Shell rates should improve.
itemNotes.MAGMA_FISH_DIAMOND: Now costs 20 Gold Magmafish to craft. Diamond Trophy Hunter also grants 20 Diamond Magmafish.
itemNotes.MYCEL: Mycelium cost for all Kuudra Key tiers reduced by roughly a third.
itemNotes.SAND:1: Red Sand cost for all Kuudra Key tiers reduced by roughly a third.

patches.title: Hypixel SkyBlock 0.20.8 - Pesthunter's Wares, Chocolate Factory Additions, and more!
patches.summary: Adds Pesthunter's Wares, where pests are used as currency for gear, plus Pest Traps and a new Field Mouse pest. Also rebalances pest crop drops, reworks Wheat recipes, and adds Chocolate Factory changes such as offline egg collection.

itemNotes.BEADY_EYES: NPC sell price raised from 1 to 1,000 coins. Its reforge now gives +1 bonus crops instead of +3.
itemNotes.BOOKWORM_BOOK: NPC sell price raised from 250 to 10,000 coins.
itemNotes.CACTUS: NPC sell price raised from 3 to 4 coins.
itemNotes.CLIPPED_WINGS: NPC sell price raised from 1 to 1,000 coins. Its reforge now grants Farming Fortune instead of Speed.
itemNotes.ENCHANTED_WHEAT: Now the main ingredient of the new Enchanted Hay Bale (160 needed) and a guaranteed Fly drop, which increases demand.
itemNotes.FINE_FLOUR: No longer works in the Sprayonator; composting is its only use now, so less demand.
itemNotes.SQUEAKY_TOY: New Field Mouse drop and the first reforge stone that grants both Farming Fortune and Bonus Pest Chance.

patches.title: [October 29] Backend Skin Changes
patches.summary: Changes how skins are handled in the backend, which affects how skins display on items, mobs, and cosmetics. Some items with old and new data stop stacking until they are dropped and picked back up.

patches.title: [October 21] Museum Patch Notes
patches.summary: Raises Auction House bid limits and removes their tie to Museum progression, with new caps from 1 billion to 50 billion coins based on SkyBlock level. Shen's Auction now unlocks at Museum Milestone 10.

patches.title: Hypixel SkyBlock 0.20.7 - Museum Overhaul, Great Spook Improvements, and more!
patches.summary: Reworks Museum progression so items grant XP by progression stage, with rewards every 100 XP including bid limits and bank upgrades. Replaces the Great Spook milestones with a Dark Candy shop and fixes many combat, mining and farming bugs.

patches.title: [October 1] Tiny Mining Balancing Update
patches.summary: Adds the Lapidary enchantment for mining tools, which drops from the Crystal Nucleus, and rebalances Bob-ombs, Oil Barrels and Pure Ores. Lowers NPC sell prices for coal, iron, gold and emerald, and fixes several fortune and forge bugs.

itemNotes.COAL: NPC sell price cut from 2 to 1 coin.
itemNotes.EMERALD: NPC sell price cut from 6 to 4 coins.
itemNotes.ENCHANTMENT_LAPIDARY_*: New enchantment book that drops from the Crystal Nucleus at weight 4000, adding a new source of supply.
itemNotes.GOLD_INGOT: NPC sell price cut from 4 to 3 coins.
itemNotes.IRON_INGOT: NPC sell price cut from 3 to 2 coins.

patches.title: [September 19] Mining Changes
patches.summary: Halves Gemstone Powder from Treasure Chests (later reverted), nerfs Mining Spread on Hard Stone and removes Gemstone Snap from the Gauntlet. Glossy Gemstone and Refined Mineral drop chances now scale with Breaking Power, and several mining bugs are fixed.

itemNotes.GLOSSY_GEMSTONE: Drop chance changed from a flat 1/725 to Breaking Power/2000 (0.3% at BP6, 0.45% at BP9). Most mining setups get more supply.
itemNotes.REFINED_MINERAL: Drop chance changed from a flat 1/350 to Breaking Power/2000 (0.3% at BP6, 0.45% at BP9). Raises supply for most mining setups.

patches.title: Hypixel SkyBlock 0.20.6 - Modernized Mining, Dye Changes, and more!
patches.summary: Large 0.20.6 mining overhaul: Heart of the Mountain reworked, new Mining Fortune sub-stats, Pure Ores, new items and a wide forge and recipe rebalance. Also reworks dye drop rates, Dwarven event rewards and adds a 2B cap on powders and essence.

itemNotes.ENCHANTED_DANDELION: Now usable as Drill Fuel (+360 Fuel), creating new demand.
itemNotes.ENCHANTED_POPPY: Now usable as Drill Fuel (+1,024 Fuel), creating new demand.
itemNotes.GLOSSY_GEMSTONE: Drop chance now scales with Breaking Power (BP/2000) instead of a flat 1/725, raising supply for most mining setups.
itemNotes.GOBLIN_EGG_BLUE: Drop rate doubled and now usable as Drill Fuel (+20,000 Fuel), adding supply and demand.
itemNotes.GOBLIN_EGG_GREEN: Now usable as Drill Fuel (+5,000 Fuel), creating new demand.
itemNotes.GOBLIN_EGG_RED: Now usable as Drill Fuel (+15,000 Fuel), creating new demand.
itemNotes.GOBLIN_EGG_YELLOW: Now usable as Drill Fuel (+10,000 Fuel), creating new demand.
itemNotes.HARD_STONE: Base mining now always drops exactly 1 Hard Stone instead of sometimes 2, slightly reducing supply.
itemNotes.MAGMA_CORE: Drop chance raised from 0.2% to 0.5%, which should increase supply.
itemNotes.PLANT_MATTER: Now usable as Drill Fuel (+150 Fuel), creating new demand.
itemNotes.REFINED_MINERAL: Drop chance now scales with Breaking Power (BP/2000) instead of a flat 1/350. Efficient Miner does not boost it.
itemNotes.TITANIUM_ORE: The Dark Monolith no longer gives 12 Titanium, so one supply source is gone.

patches.title: Hypixel SkyBlock 0.20.5 - Artist’s Abode
patches.summary: Opens the Artist's Abode, where Vincent boosts three dyes each year and offers a Dye Compendium. Rebalances many dye drop rates and sources, adds several new dyes and fixes a number of dungeon, mining and item bugs.

patches.title: Hypixel SkyBlock Patch Notes 0.20.4 - Bazaar Overbidding Protection and Bug Fixes
patches.summary: Adds Bazaar overbidding protection: confirmation popups for buys above 2x or insta-sells below half of the 7-day average price, and a 10x cap on sell offers. Also fixes Better Mayors issues and a long list of bugs.

patches.title: Hypixel SkyBlock Patch Notes 0.20.3 - Better Mayors
patches.summary: Reworks mayor perks and elections with a fourth perk slot, a Minister system, and new or revised perks for several mayors. Mining Fiesta is split into five shorter events that double Refined Mineral and Glossy Gemstone drops.

itemNotes.ECTOPLASM: Party Chests and Party Gifts also buff Trick or Treat Chest and Red Gift loot. The post's example goes from 4 to 6 Ectoplasm.
itemNotes.FINE_FLOUR: Garden visitors give Fine Flour while Finnegan's Blooming Business perk is active, at 1 to 10 per visitor by rarity. Adds a new supply source.
itemNotes.GLOSSY_GEMSTONE: Mining Fiesta now gives 2x drops, including Glossy Gemstones, and new forge recipes consume them.
itemNotes.REFINED_MINERAL: Mining Fiesta now gives 2x drops, including Refined Minerals, and new forge recipes consume them. Expect more supply during events.

patches.title: [June 10] SkyBlock Patch Notes
patches.summary: Crystal Hollows hotfix: titanium and polished diorite respawn correctly, the Magma Fields heat cap is fixed, and mithril and gemstone ores respawn even after their chunk unloads.

patches.title: Hypixel SkyBlock Patch Notes 0.20.2 - Chocolate Factory, Glacite Changes, and more!
patches.summary: Expands the Chocolate Factory with two new rabbit employees, a Prestige 5 with Divine rabbits, and shop milestones. Glacite changes adjust scrap odds and Vanguard loot, and the Toxophilite bow enchant is added.

itemNotes.ENCHANTED_BONE_BLOCK: Now has an NPC sell price, so it can be sold to NPCs.

patches.title: Hypixel SkyBlock Patch Notes 0.20.1 - Chocolate Factory, Hoppity’s Hunt, and more!
patches.summary: Launches Hoppity's Hunt egg event and the Chocolate Factory, along with Dark Auction changes. Glacite Tunnels get a Mineshaft pity system, a rewritten Vanguard loot table, and forge time changes, and Pet Cake XP is buffed tenfold.

itemNotes.DERELICT_ASHE: Tier 1 Blaze Slayer drops raised from 2-3 to 6-8 Derelict Ashe.
itemNotes.GLACITE: Now requires 3 base fuel to mine, which slows how fast it can be farmed.
itemNotes.GLACITE_AMALGAMATION: Recipe adjusted; the post does not list the new recipe.
itemNotes.PET_CAKE: Pet Cake XP raised from 1,000 to 10,000, making each cake far more effective for leveling pets.
itemNotes.REFINED_TUNGSTEN: Forge time set to 1 hour and the forge requirement raised to HOTM 7.
itemNotes.REFINED_UMBER: Forge time set to 1 hour and the forge requirement raised to HOTM 7.
itemNotes.SUSPICIOUS_SCRAP: Drops at most 5 times per Mineshaft with a much lower chance of containing a fossil. Odds fall with each scrap found in the same Mineshaft.
itemNotes.TUNGSTEN: Now requires 3 base fuel to mine, which slows how fast it can be farmed.
itemNotes.TUNGSTEN_KEY: Recipe adjusted; the post does not list the new recipe.
itemNotes.TUNGSTEN_PLATE: Forge time set to 3 hours and the forge requirement raised to HOTM 7.
itemNotes.UMBER: Now requires 3 base fuel to mine, which slows how fast it can be farmed.
itemNotes.UMBER_KEY: Recipe adjusted; the post does not list the new recipe.
itemNotes.UMBER_PLATE: Forge time set to 3 hours and the forge requirement raised to HOTM 7.

patches.title: [April 11] Small Glacite Patch Notes
patches.summary: Significantly raises Mineshaft spawn chances in the Glacite Tunnels for many block types. Also fixes a cold-reset exploit using Enderpearls and a Corpses Widget bug.

patches.title: Hypixel SkyBlock Patch Notes 0.20 - The Glacite Tunnels
patches.summary: Introduces the Glacite Tunnels, with the Dwarven Base Camp, three new ores and collections, new gemstones, and Cold Resistance. Adds Glacite Mineshafts, Frozen Corpses, a Fossil Excavator, and HOTM tiers 8 to 10.

itemNotes.GLACITE: New ore mined in the Glacite Tunnels. Gives Glacite Mineshafts and Frozen Corpses a new source of supply.
itemNotes.SUSPICIOUS_SCRAP: New item found in Glacite Mineshafts. Excavated in the Fossil Excavator for treasure and fossil pieces.
itemNotes.TUNGSTEN: New ore mined in the Glacite Tunnels, used in new key and plate recipes.
itemNotes.UMBER: New ore mined in the Glacite Tunnels, used in new key and plate recipes.

patches.title: [March 26] SkyBlock Patch Notes
patches.summary: Fixes an exploit that spawned extra pests, pests appearing in uncleaned plots, and a Magma Lord armor bonus that worked without its requirements. Also fixes stacked items being deleted during recombobulation.

patches.title: [March 19] Community Center Upgrade City Project
patches.summary: Announces a new Community Center city project upgrade and hints at new mayor perks to come. The project will go to Alpha before release.

patches.title: [March 18] SkyBlock Patch Notes
patches.summary: Bug-fix patch covering healing from damage with very high defense, incorrect auction durations, and Garden plot cleanup progress that could leave new plots uncleanable. Also fixes several tablist and Bestiary display issues.

patches.title: SkyBlock Patch Notes 0.19.12 - Tablist and Other Changes
patches.summary: Launches the Tablist Widgets system and the General's Medallion dungeon accessory. Pests spawn more often and drop more common items, many pets are reworked, and Arachne Fangs and Fragments join the Bazaar.

itemNotes.ARACHNE_FANG: Added to the Bazaar, which gives it a new market.
itemNotes.ARACHNE_FRAGMENT: Added to the Bazaar, which gives it a new market.
itemNotes.CHEESE_FUEL: Pest drop chance raised from 4% to 10% for all pest types.
itemNotes.COMPOST: Pest drop chance raised from 4% to 10% for all pest types.
itemNotes.DUNG: Pest drop chance raised from 4% to 10% for all pest types.
itemNotes.ENCHANTED_BAKED_POTATO: Locust pest drop chance raised from 1% to 3%.
itemNotes.ENCHANTED_CACTUS: Mite pest drop chance raised from 1% to 2%.
itemNotes.ENCHANTED_COOKIE: Moth pest drop chance raised from 1% to 3%.
itemNotes.ENCHANTED_GOLDEN_CARROT: Cricket pest drop chance raised from 1% to 3%.
itemNotes.ENCHANTED_MELON_BLOCK: Earthworm pest drop chance raised from 1% to 4%.
itemNotes.ENCHANTED_ROTTEN_FLESH: Zombie Pet recipe now needs 128 instead of 512, lowering demand for it.
itemNotes.ENCHANTED_SUGAR_CANE: Mosquito pest drop chance raised from 1% to 2%.
itemNotes.HONEY_JAR: Pest drop chance raised from 4% to 10% for all pest types.
itemNotes.MUTANT_NETHER_STALK: Beetle pest drop chance raised from 1% to 3%.
itemNotes.PLANT_MATTER: Pest drop chance raised from 4% to 10% for all pest types.

patches.title: [February 22] Supercraft Update
patches.summary: Adds Supercraft for VIP+ players, which crafts items from inventory, Ender Chests, backpacks and sacks, plus a /recipe command. Also expands Quickcraft to show all options and fixes several item and Shen's Auction bugs.

patches.title: SkyBlock Patch Notes 0.19.11 - Stackable God Potions and Other Improvements
patches.summary: Reworks God Potion durations so they can be stacked under 7 days, and lets Mixins be consumed for longer effects. Enchantment book recipes are replaced by EXP discounts, and Poison Sample and Polarvoid Books join the Bazaar.

itemNotes.ESSENCE_DRAGON: New sink: the Void Sword can be turned into a dungeon item using Dragon Essence.
itemNotes.ESSENCE_SPIDER: New sink: Souls Rebound, Venom's Touch and Spider Queen's Stinger can be turned into dungeon items using Spider Essence.
itemNotes.FLOWERING_BOUQUET: Can now be placed in a composter for 6k Organic Matter, giving it a new use.
itemNotes.POISON_SAMPLE: Added to the Bazaar, which gives it a new market.
itemNotes.POLARVOID_BOOK: Added to the Bazaar, which gives it a new market.

patches.title: SkyBlock Patch Notes 0.19.10 - Fann Changes and Other Improvements
patches.summary: Cheapens Fann's pet training and raises the pet XP from Carrot Candies. Doubles Precious Pearl drops from Nucleus Runs, greatly raises the Corleonite drop rate, and adds Guardian Lucky Block and Magma Core to the Bazaar.

itemNotes.AGARIMOO_TONGUE: Gained an NPC price of 2,050 coins.
itemNotes.CORLEONITE: Drop rate significantly increased, so expect more supply.
itemNotes.PRECIOUS_PEARL: Drop rate from Nucleus Runs doubled.
itemNotes.SLEEPY_HOLLOW: Now listed in the Bazaar's minion upgrades section.
itemNotes.WORM_BAIT: Fixed so it can be traded on the Bazaar.

patches.title: [December 15] SkyBlock Patch Notes
patches.summary: Magic Find no longer boosts loot-share drops where the mob's owner wouldn't get Magic Find. Chat now shows your own Magic Find, and /eq works normally again after combat.

patches.title: [December 13] Fann Day One Patch
patches.summary: Reworks Fann's Pet Training tiers with much more pet EXP per day and lower coin costs. Using Ultimate Carrot Candy on a training pet through the Caducous Feeder now refunds the plan's coin-per-EXP cost difference.

itemNotes.ULTIMATE_CARROT_CANDY: Fed to a pet in a training session via the Caducous Feeder, it refunds the plan's cost difference per EXP.

patches.title: SkyBlock Patch Notes 0.19.9 - Pet Training and Bestiary Changes
patches.summary: Puts Egg, Magma Core, Guardian Lucky Block and Jungle Heart on the Bazaar and grants +5 Dragon Essence per dragon kill (double for Superior). Also adds pet trainer Fann, a Stranded Bestiary and an Island Properties menu.

itemNotes.CHEESE_FUEL: Fixed Rat pet generating Tasty Cheese in the Garden, removing an unintended supply source.
itemNotes.ENCHANTED_GLOWSTONE: Fixed NPC sell price, which was too high after the recipe change.
itemNotes.ESSENCE_DRAGON: +5 Dragon Essence per Dragon kill in the End, doubled for Superior Dragons, so more supply.
itemNotes.METAPHYSICAL_SERUM: Suggested Bazaar amount for instabuys and buy orders lowered from 4 to 3.
itemNotes.WHIPPED_MAGMA_CREAM: Super Compactor 3000 paired with a Magma Cube Minion now crafts it correctly.

patches.title: [December 7] SkyBlock Patch Notes
patches.summary: Fixes past Advent Calendar days being unclaimable and makes claimed rewards clearer. Adds the /sbadvent command, plus sort and filter options for potion effect menus.

patches.title: [December 5] SkyBlock Patch Notes
patches.summary: Adds a Pet Care Expansion City Project with an NPC that trains multiple pets at once. Also fixes Fairy Souls and gift progress not saving, and makes Matriarch Perfume's cooldown reset daily.

patches.title: SkyBlock Patch Notes 0.19.8 - Winter Update and Secret Bingo
patches.summary: Winter update with a new Advent Calendar, Generow gift rewards and Secret Bingo. Volcanic Rock now drops from the final intact Battle of Jerry gift pile and buys items at Einary's shop, and old Bottles of Jyrre leave Sherry's shop.

itemNotes.FROZEN_BAIT: Added to the Glacial Cave loot table and to Generow's gift rewards, adding new supply sources.
itemNotes.MAGIC_TOP_HAT: Now buyable at Einary's shop with Volcanic Rock, and used to upgrade Snowman to Mythic.
itemNotes.VOLCANIC_ROCK: Dropped by the final intact gift pile of each Battle of Jerry Mountain event and spent at Einary's shop.

patches.title: SkyBlock Patch Notes 0.19.7 - Garden Pests
patches.summary: Adds Garden Pests from Garden Level V, each with its own drop table, and a Farming Fortune-based chance for rarer pest drops. Also reworks Jacob's Contest medal brackets, adds Diamond and Platinum tiers, and lowers crop milestone requirements.

itemNotes.CHEESE_FUEL: Rat pest drop at 4%, a new supply source.
itemNotes.COMPOST: Rat pest drop at 4%, a new supply source.
itemNotes.DUNG: Rat pest drop at 4%, a new supply source.
itemNotes.ENCHANTED_PUMPKIN: Rat pest drops it at 100%, multiplied by Farming and Pumpkin Fortune. A new supply source.
itemNotes.HONEY_JAR: Rat pest drop at 4%, a new supply source.
itemNotes.PET_ITEM_EXP_SHARE_DROP: Fixed level 10 Emerald Slimes having a lower Exp Share Core drop chance than level 5.
itemNotes.PLANT_MATTER: Rat pest drop at 4%, a new supply source.
itemNotes.POLISHED_PUMPKIN: Rat pest drop at 1%, a new supply source.

patches.title: [November 9] SkyBlock Patch Notes
patches.summary: Fixes Sky Mall's 5x Titanium buff and very low Worm spawn rates without the Treasure of the Earth perk. Clarifies that the 30-second worm spawn cooldown is per player, and fixes null heads dropping in the Floor 3 boss fight.

patches.title: [November 6] SkyBlock Patch Notes
patches.summary: Fixes Looting, Luck, Chance and Reflection enchantments not working on several sources, including rods, Enderman kills and arrows. Also removes the time-of-day restriction on Rat spawns and fixes a Crimson Armor Swipe duplicate-reward bug.

patches.title: [October 31] Great Spook Event Post-Patch Fixes!
patches.summary: Primal Fears now spawn after 6 minutes minus 3 seconds per Fear you have, and Vargul's milestone menu gets buttons to give candy. Also nerfs the Deadline timer from 8s to 5s and fixes double rewards for Commitment Phobias.

itemNotes.DARK_CANDY: Primal Fears spawn sooner, so Dark Candy from them should come in faster.

patches.title: [October 30] Co-op Management Re-Enabled
patches.summary: Co-op Management is back (right-click a co-op in /profiles), /coopadd is updated, /coopclear cancels pending invites, and private-world shortages during busy events like raffles are reduced.

patches.title: [October 26] SkyBlock Patch Notes
patches.summary: Lets Ironman players claim Tyashoi's items once per profile and brings back the Head of Betrayal. Fixes a potion brewing exploit and Nightmare Nullifier being smeltable, and raises the Diamond Goblin Bestiary bracket from 5 to 7.

patches.title: SkyBlock Patch Notes 0.19.6 - The Great Spook, Essence Shops, & More
patches.summary: Launches The Great Spook 2023 with Primal Fears and Dark Candy, and adds Gold and Diamond Essence shops. Gold and Diamond Essence can now come from Crystal Hollows chests, and four essence types from Dungeon secret loot.

itemNotes.DARK_CANDY: Dropped by Primal Fears during the Great Spook. Vargul's milestones unlock items as you donate it.
itemNotes.ESSENCE_DIAMOND: New Diamond Essence shop. Now also drops from Crystal Hollows treasure chests and Dungeon secret loot.
itemNotes.ESSENCE_GOLD: New Gold Essence shop. Now also drops from Crystal Hollows treasure chests and Dungeon secret loot.
itemNotes.ESSENCE_ICE: Now drops from Dungeon secret loot.
itemNotes.ESSENCE_SPIDER: Now drops from Dungeon secret loot.
itemNotes.WHALE_BAIT: Now only affects the lava sea creatures (Lava Flame, Fire Eel, Taurus, Thunder, Lord Jawbus), whose catch weights were raised 4x to compensate.

patches.title: [October 16] SkyBlock Patch Notes
patches.summary: Fixes Elle quest progression on the Crimson Isle and Blaze Slayer boss spawn and teleport bugs. Also fixes Bonemerang damage, Smelting Touch giving too much collection progress on cactus, and Auto-Pickup on Launch Pads.

patches.title: [October 10] SkyBlock Patch Notes
patches.summary: Reverts the change that let Flower of Truth and Bouquet of Lies damage Ghosts, after community feedback. The revert rolls out gradually over the day.

patches.title: [October 9] SkyBlock Patch Notes
patches.summary: Fixes Champion not multiplying Combat XP on some mobs, Spirit Bow drops in Dungeons and Dwarven Mines sign parsing. Dwarven Gold in the Mines of Divan now drops more.

patches.title: SkyBlock Patch Notes 0.19.5
patches.summary: Cuts Inferno Minion fuel costs and raises Inferno Vertex, Apex and Chili Pepper drops. Gabagool Distillate becomes a more common distillate, Capsaicin Eyedrops become Bazaar-listed, and Enchanted Glowstone and Amalgamated Crimsonite get cheaper to craft.

itemNotes.AMALGAMATED_CRIMSONITE_NEW: Recipe now outputs 2 per craft, halving the cost. Can also be crafted in bulk from enchanted block variants.
itemNotes.CAPSAICIN_EYEDROPS_NO_CHARGES: Now stackable with 1 charge, with a recipe using Exportable Carrots and listed on the Bazaar under Inferno Minions.
itemNotes.CHILI_PEPPER: Hypergolic-tier fuel yields 15% more Chili Peppers from Inferno Minions.
itemNotes.CRUDE_GABAGOOL_DISTILLATE: Distillate weight rebalanced: Gabagool Distillate goes from 500 to 1400 while other distillates go from 900 to 700. Expect more supply.
itemNotes.ENCHANTED_BLAZE_POWDER: Inferno Demonlord now has a good chance of dropping extra Enchanted Blaze Powder.
itemNotes.ENCHANTED_GLOWSTONE: Recipe now uses 160 of its ingredient instead of 196, making it cheaper to craft.
itemNotes.INFERNO_APEX: Hypergolic-tier fuel yields 20% more Inferno Apex from Inferno Minions.
itemNotes.INFERNO_VERTEX: Hypergolic-tier fuel yields 2.8x more Inferno Vertex from Inferno Minions.
itemNotes.VERY_CRUDE_GABAGOOL: New item that can be compacted in a Super Compactor 3000.

patches.title: [September 26] SkyBlock Patch Notes
patches.summary: Fixes crit modifiers not affecting Soul Eater and fire ticks surviving a Dungeon boss teleport. Replaces Fetchur's Nether Quartz Ore quest with Emerald and lets Mage Beam hit Fairies.

patches.title: SkyBlock Patch Notes 0.19.4 - Dungeons, QoL, Bug Fixes
patches.summary: Reworks Berserk with a swing-range cone attack and adds a Swing Range stat plus new Catacombs weapons and necklaces. Adds Dark Orb to F5/M5 emerald chests, removes Ancient Rose from some chest loot, and eases many dungeon item requirements.

itemNotes.DARK_ORB: Added to the F5/M5 emerald-and-above chest loot tables, which should also make it show in the RNG Meter. Small supply increase from dungeon chests.
itemNotes.GOLEM_POPPY: Ancient Rose removed from the Emerald, Obsidian and Bedrock chest drop tables, so less of it comes from dungeon chests.
itemNotes.THORN_FRAGMENT: Spirit Bear is now a miniboss from F5/M5 onward that drops Thorn Fragments, a new source used to upgrade F4/M4 items.

patches.title: SkyBlock - Year 300
patches.summary: Year 300 Century event: Simon hands out random Century Cakes, including two new ones, and the Rezzus raffle runs all year with speed, daily and final draws plus team-based rewards.

patches.title: [September 2] Year 300 Pre-Release
patches.summary: Announces that Year 300 Century Event preparations are live at the Hub Community Center ahead of a server-wide raffle with new items.

patches.title: [August 29] SkyBlock Patch Notes
patches.summary: Adds Mithril and Gemstone Powder mining-speed buffs to various picks and drills, ranging from 5 to 20 percent, along with a batch of typo, formatting and capitalization fixes.

patches.title: [August 25] SkyBlock Patch Notes
patches.summary: Small hotfix after 0.19.3: adds a loot-chest hint for Great Explorer, fixes compactor and deletor duplicates, Prehistoric Egg armadillo rarity, dungeon chest shiny gear costs, and slayer boss and commission issues.

patches.title: [August 24] SkyBlock Patch Notes
patches.summary: Fixes Bestiary and Combat/Fishing EXP awards, Ultimate Wise mana cost handling, a set of wrongful combat tags, Automaton damage after death, and a Champion enchant fishing EXP bug, plus a few Anvil and rod-swap fixes.

patches.title: SkyBlock Patch 0.19.3 - Crystal Hollows, QoL, & Bug Fixes
patches.summary: Major Crystal Hollows update: Armadillo revamp, Mines of Divan respawn and chest loot changes, and a Bazaar redesign that lists Ascension Rope and Wishing Compass. Also adds Rift achievements, new Bits sources, and many dungeon and Kuudra QoL changes.

itemNotes.ASCENSION_ROPE: Now listed on the Bazaar and stackable, so more of it can be bought and stored directly.
itemNotes.ENCHANTED_BONE_MEAL: Its cost was cut in half because it was considered too expensive. Likely cheaper to make or buy, which can raise supply.
itemNotes.ENCHANTED_BROWN_MUSHROOM: Can now be crafted from blocks, which adds an alternate crafting route.
itemNotes.ENCHANTED_RED_MUSHROOM: Can now be crafted from blocks, which adds an alternate crafting route.
itemNotes.ENCHANTED_STRING: Recipe cut from 192 String to 160 String, making it cheaper to craft.
itemNotes.FLAWED_AMBER_GEM: Mines of Divan chests now give 1 or 2 Flawed Amber in place of 8 or 16 Rough Amber.
itemNotes.FLAWED_AMETHYST_GEM: Mines of Divan chests now give 1 or 2 Flawed Amethyst in place of 8 or 16 Rough Amethyst.
itemNotes.FLAWED_JADE_GEM: Mines of Divan chests now give 2 or 4 Flawed Jade in place of 32 or 64 Rough Jade.
itemNotes.FLAWED_JASPER_GEM: Mines of Divan chests now give 1 Flawed Jasper in place of 8 Rough Jasper. New Flawed source from these chests.
itemNotes.FLAWED_RUBY_GEM: Mines of Divan chests now give 2 or 4 Flawed Ruby in place of 32 or 64 Rough Ruby. More Flawed Ruby from these chests.
itemNotes.FLAWED_SAPPHIRE_GEM: Mines of Divan chests now give 1 or 2 Flawed Sapphire in place of 8 or 16 Rough Sapphire.
itemNotes.FLAWED_TOPAZ_GEM: Mines of Divan chests now give 1 or 2 Flawed Topaz in place of 8 or 16 Rough Topaz.
itemNotes.OIL_BARREL: Can now be sold to NPCs for 1,000 coins each, which gives it a fixed coin floor.
itemNotes.ROUGH_AMBER_GEM: Mines of Divan chests now give Flawed Amber (1 or 2) instead of 8 or 16 Rough Amber.
itemNotes.ROUGH_AMETHYST_GEM: Mines of Divan chests now give Flawed Amethyst (1 or 2) instead of 8 or 16 Rough Amethyst.
itemNotes.ROUGH_JADE_GEM: Mines of Divan chests now give Flawed Jade (2 or 4) instead of 32 or 64 Rough Jade.
itemNotes.ROUGH_JASPER_GEM: Mines of Divan chests now give 40 Rough Jasper instead of 4, and 1 Flawed Jasper instead of 8 Rough Jasper.
itemNotes.ROUGH_RUBY_GEM: Mines of Divan chests now give Flawed Ruby (2 or 4) instead of 32 or 64 Rough Ruby, so fewer Rough Ruby enter supply from chests.
itemNotes.ROUGH_SAPPHIRE_GEM: Mines of Divan chests now give Flawed Sapphire (1 or 2) instead of 8 or 16 Rough Sapphire.
itemNotes.ROUGH_TOPAZ_GEM: Mines of Divan chests now give Flawed Topaz (1 or 2) instead of 8 or 16 Rough Topaz.
itemNotes.WISHING_COMPASS: Now listed on the Bazaar and single-use per item, but each source now gives 3 compasses. Stackable. Effective supply from drops rises sharply.

patches.title: [August 15] SkyBlock Patch Notes
patches.summary: Fixes Combat EXP and Bestiary progress from ability kills, several Midas Staff ability bugs, Sea Creature despawning when the owner leaves, and Barn crop regeneration using all three Crystals.

patches.title: [August 8] SkyBlock Patch Notes
patches.summary: Fixes very high Fishing Speed causing long fishing times, duplicate Experience Bottle pairs in the Experimentation Table, and re-enables the Sinseeker Scythe ability with a cancel-on-teleport rule.

patches.title: [August 3rd] SkyBlock Patch Notes
patches.summary: Migrates Dungeons and Kuudra to a unified backend: re-joining after a disconnect, instant requeue for the party leader, queue retries, respawn invulnerability, and blood-skip checks.

patches.title: SkyBlock Patch 0.19.2 - Bestiary, QoL, & Bug Fixes
patches.summary: Reworks the Bestiary with new mob categories, per-mob kill caps and claimable milestone rewards, and adds Fishing settings, Metaphysical Serum rewards, and Mixed Mite Gel on the Bazaar. Also includes many mob spawn-rate and bug fixes.

itemNotes.EMERALD: Mining Fortune now applies to emeralds in the Mines of Divan, so yields go up with Fortune.
itemNotes.ICE_BAIT: Fixed bulk-buy in the Winter Island shop, so players can now buy stacks from the NPC.
itemNotes.METAPHYSICAL_SERUM: Added as a Superpairs reward alongside Daily Experiments, which is a new source of supply.
itemNotes.MIXED_MITE_GEL: Added to the Bazaar, so its supply and price now trade there.
itemNotes.REDSTONE: Redstone mined in the Mines of Divan is now affected by Mining Fortune, so yields scale with Fortune.

patches.title: [July 25] SkyBlock Patch Notes
patches.summary: Blocks Auction House use during combat, fixes Livid Dagger double damage and Execute on magic damage, sends Special Zealot drops into Sacks, and adds Gold and Diamond Trophy Fish emblems.

patches.title: [July 18] SkyBlock Patch Notes
patches.summary: Fixes Remnant of the Eye, Chum Bucket filling for Ironman co-op players, duplicate Experimentation Table rewards, and nick handling in a few Dungeon spots.

patches.title: SkyBlock Patch 0.19.1 - Item Linking, Leveling Update, Stash QoL, & Bug Fixes
patches.summary: Adds item linking through /show, a leveling update with emblems and the Book of Progression, /viewstash, and a daily coin trade cap. Also includes many fixes, including Bazaar handling for Enchanted Lava Bucket and Super Compactor 3000.

itemNotes.ENCHANTED_LAVA_BUCKET: The Bazaar was treating it as stackable. Fixed so it is no longer handled as a stackable product.
itemNotes.SUPER_COMPACTOR_3000: Co-op soulbound copies can no longer be sold on the Bazaar.

patches.title: [June 29] SkyBlock Patch Notes
patches.summary: Fixes Sea Creature Fishing EXP under specific conditions, long waits after a missed fish, Talisman of Coins despawning, unintended nick leaks, and menus closing when a Dungeon starts.

patches.title: Resolution to Rift Access (6/26/23)
patches.summary: Explains the June 26 Rift closure: an item-transfer exploit led to removing Rift-brought items, with recovered items sent to an NPC at the Wizard Tower and items taken out deleted.

patches.title: [June 26] SkyBlock Patch Notes
patches.summary: Bug-fix patch covering Sea Creature Fishing EXP, Midas Staff TNT spam, Metal Detector activation, Crystal Hollows respawn, Ascension Rope spawns, and the Bazaar sell-all menu, plus /backpack and /wardrobe QoL.

patches.title: [June 26] Rift Shen's Changes
patches.summary: Tags several Vampire Slayer drops as Rift-Exportable and lowers motes values for Hemoglass and Hemobomb, keeping Shen's motes economy separate from coins.

itemNotes.BUBBA_BLISTER: Now tagged Rift-Exportable, so it can leave the Rift and enter the main world. Likely adds supply.
itemNotes.CHOCOLATE_CHIP: Now tagged Rift-Exportable, so it can leave the Rift and enter the main world. Likely adds supply.
itemNotes.GUARDIAN_LUCKY_BLOCK: Now tagged Rift-Exportable, so it can leave the Rift and enter the main world. Likely adds supply.
itemNotes.HEMOBOMB: Rift motes value cut from 1200 to 400. Affects Rift-side value only.
itemNotes.HEMOGLASS: Rift motes value cut from 80 to 25. Affects Rift-side value only.

patches.title: [June 23] Rift Day 3 Patch
patches.summary: Rift day-3 patch: many bug fixes, Rift Ferret now levels like a regular combat pet, Blood Ichor and Killer Spring spawn fixes, and Riftstalker tuning that makes the boss harder at T5.

patches.title: [June 21] Undead Patch
patches.summary: Undead patch: the Zombie pet Living Dead perk now affects all stats and impacted armor is tagged undead. Adds a Lost and Found notice, several Museum items, and removes the BIN limit on uncommon items.

patches.title: SkyBlock Patch 0.19 - The Rift
patches.summary: Launches The Rift, an alternate Hub dimension with its own Motes currency, Shen's Auctions inside, a Rift Guide, and the Riftstalker Bloodfiend slayer. Rift items stay separate from the main world.

patches.title: [June 14] SkyBlock Patch Notes
patches.summary: Bug fixes for Quick Craft showing vanilla items, Crimson Isle status effects, Garden candy going into Sacks, Melody perfect rewards, and Hunter Ring Recombobulator transfer, plus a few crashes.

patches.title: SkyBlock - 4th Anniversary!
patches.summary: Anniversary week: Party Hats from Simon, a 20 percent Skill EXP boost, the Pig Shop returning with some price increases and the Dante Ring, plus a four-year video and a look back at past patches.

patches.title: [June 7] SkyBlock Patch Notes
patches.summary: Bug fixes for pets blocking placement, Cleave doing zero damage, custom mining zones, Frost Walker activation, and the Archer Explosive Shot cooldown, plus QoL such as an /ec page argument.

patches.title: SkyBlock Patch 0.18.5 - Abiphone Contacts, Dungeons Balancing, & Bug Fixes
patches.summary: Lowers NPC sell prices of Carrot, Nether Wart, Potato and Sugar Cane to slow Farming income. Makes Recombobulator 3000 and the Necron's Handle scrolls more common in Dungeons, and raises Bin listing fees to 2% and 2.5% for higher-priced items.

itemNotes.CARROT_ITEM: NPC sell price lowered from 4 to 3 coins to curb Farming coin income.
itemNotes.CLAY_BALL: Slightly higher fishing rate at the Fisherman's Hut, adding a little supply.
itemNotes.IMPLOSION_SCROLL: Dungeon drop weight raised (F7 14 to 20, M7 14 to 25) and chest price raised to 50M from 15M.
itemNotes.NETHER_STALK: NPC sell price lowered from 5 to 4 coins to curb Farming coin income.
itemNotes.POTATO_ITEM: NPC sell price lowered from 4 to 3 coins to curb Farming coin income.
itemNotes.RECOMBOBULATOR_3000: Dungeon drop weights raised on most floors, and chest price raised by 1M. Expect more supply over time.
itemNotes.SHADOW_WARP_SCROLL: Dungeon drop weight raised (F7 14 to 20, M7 14 to 25) and chest price raised to 50M from 15M.
itemNotes.SUGAR_CANE: NPC sell price lowered from 5 to 4 coins to curb Farming coin income.
itemNotes.WITHER_SHIELD_SCROLL: Dungeon drop weight raised (F7 14 to 20, M7 14 to 25) and chest price raised to 50M from 15M.

patches.title: [May 26] Repair Wizard Portal City Project
patches.summary: Opens a city project in the hub community center to repair the Wizard Portal. Helping Barry and the Wizard over the next few days unlocks Mementos, a new collectible item type.

patches.title: SkyBlock Patch 0.18.4 - Sack Additions & Bug Fixes
patches.summary: Adds a batch of new items to existing Sacks, including Enchanted blocks, cooked foods and Kuudra Teeth, and lets Red Sand and Mycelium into the Mining Sack. Also fixes many bugs, such as the Dungeons RNG Meter not resetting and Crop Milestone progress going negative.
