patches.title: [March 24] Various Grammatical Fixes
patches.summary: Mostly grammar, spelling and description fixes across items, dialogue and menus. Also corrects the NPC sell price of Enchanted Red Sand and renames the Coco Chopper to Cocoa Chopper.

itemNotes.ENCHANTED_RED_SAND: NPC sell price corrected; it had been selling for too little.

patches.title: [March 21] SkyBlock Patch Notes
patches.summary: Fixes Garden bugs, including mushrooms from the Mooshroom pet not counting toward milestones, Fermento set bonus issues, and lamps disappearing when placed. Bazaar purchases made from the Garden now always buy the full plot amount.

patches.title: SkyBlock Patch 0.18.1 - Achievements & Bug Fixes
patches.summary: Adds a set of Garden and general achievements plus Garden fixes. Enchanted Red and Brown Mushroom Blocks now sell to NPCs for 20,480 coins instead of 2,300.

itemNotes.ENCHANTED_HUGE_MUSHROOM_1: NPC sell price raised from 2,300 to 20,480 coins.
itemNotes.ENCHANTED_HUGE_MUSHROOM_2: NPC sell price raised from 2,300 to 20,480 coins.

patches.title: [February 28] SkyBlock Patch Notes
patches.summary: Scales Garden experience from visitors with Garden level, disables fire spread in the Garden, and fixes several farming bugs such as the Farming Talisman not working and Cultivating not adding fortune.

itemNotes.ENCHANTED_HUGE_MUSHROOM_1: Personal Compactor recipe fixed; it had stopped working.
itemNotes.ENCHANTED_HUGE_MUSHROOM_2: Personal Compactor recipe fixed; it had stopped working.

patches.title: [February 22] SkyBlock Patch Notes
patches.summary: Fixes Fermento Armor and several Garden soft-locks and bugs, sets a 10-block build height above bedrock, and speeds up Nether Wart and mushroom growth. Mycelium is moved back to only the Mining section of the Bazaar.

itemNotes.BROWN_MUSHROOM: Growth speed increased, and mushroom growth is no longer capped by nearby mushrooms.
itemNotes.MYCEL: Listed only under the Mining section of the Bazaar again.
itemNotes.NETHER_STALK: Growth speed increased, raising potential Garden Nether Wart output.
itemNotes.RED_MUSHROOM: Growth speed increased, and mushroom growth is no longer capped by nearby mushrooms.

patches.title: [February 16] Final Dungeon Journals
patches.summary: Releases the last seven Dungeon Journals on floors 6 and 7. Each journal now appears whole instead of as pages, and journals gain author names and clearer date notes.

patches.title: SkyBlock Patch 0.18 - The Garden
patches.summary: Introduces The Garden, a farming island unlocked at SkyBlock Level 5 with plots, a Barn, Composter, SkyMart, visitors and Garden Levels. Crop upgrades add Farming Fortune, Copper becomes a Garden-only currency, and new Farming armor is added.

itemNotes.BOX_OF_SEEDS: New item that needs 160 Enchanted Seeds to craft.
itemNotes.ENCHANTED_SEEDS: Used as the 160-unit ingredient in the new Box of Seeds recipe, adding demand.

patches.title: [February 6] SkyBlock Patch Notes
patches.summary: Restores missing SkyBlock experience from several sources, including the Spooky Festival, Dungeon floor completions and Trophy Fishing.

patches.title: [February 3] Autopet Changes
patches.summary: Raises the Autopet rule limit to 28, but only two rules can trigger at the same time.

patches.title: [February 2] Patch 0.17.3 Bug Fixes
patches.summary: Fixes Guide Menu suggestions and grammar, a SkyBlock Level that could show as 0, Mithril mining notifications, and a Heart of the Mountain perk duplication bug.

patches.title: SkyBlock Patch 0.17.3 - Guide Menu & SkyBlock Menu Updates
patches.summary: Adds the SkyBlock Guide Menu with seven game stages of tasks and reorganizes the SkyBlock menu. Trades move into the Recipe Book, bags get their own menu with shortcut commands, and a Booster Cookie menu and persistent Cookie Clicker are added.

itemNotes.BOOSTER_COOKIE: Can now be bought directly from the new Booster Cookie menu, which also allows instant selling while the Cookie buff is active.

patches.title: SkyBlock Patch 0.17.2 - Leveling Part 2
patches.summary: Adds 23 new ways to earn SkyBlock XP and redesigns the level menus. Also rebalances several XP sources and changes Museum valuation to use Bazaar prices plus item modifiers.

patches.title: [January 10th] Some Bug Fixes
patches.summary: Fixes Wither Cloak, Thorn Spirit Bow, Bonzo Mask and Kuudra bugs, and tweaks Dungeon door speed and the Fresh Tools Kuudra perk, which now scales from 5% to 15%.

patches.title: [January 5th] Knockback Resistance changes
patches.summary: Reworks knockback immunity so the Slime Hat, Dwarf Turtle Shelmet, Unflippable Turtle perk and Dungeons Tank resistance always cancel knockback and no longer override each other.

patches.title: [December 14] Winter Follow Up
patches.summary: Follow-up to the Jerry's Workshop update. Gifts drop North Stars outside December, the Nutcracker armor recipe costs three times as much, and the Reindeer pet's cost and perks are retuned.

patches.title: [December 13] SkyBlock Patch Notes
patches.summary: Kuudra balance pass that cuts Fuel Cells needed for the Ballista in Phase 3, raises Phase 4 health, and adjusts stun damage and Steady Aim scaling. Also fixes the Nuke perk and a Wither King dragon prioritization issue.

patches.title: [December 8] SkyBlock Kuudra Infernal Follow-up Patch Notes 1
patches.summary: Kuudra fixes: Rusty's Kuudra Chunk requirements, abilities blocked early in the fight, random Kuudra pet stats, the Revive Item, and respawning outside the arena when dying before the boss.

patches.title: SkyBlock 0.17.1 - Kuudra Infernal Tier, Party Finder and more!
patches.summary: Releases the Kuudra Infernal tier with a new boss phase and attributes, plus a Kuudra party finder, a Kuudra boss collection and new Crimson Essence perks. The Wither Cloak and Werewolf armor are nerfed.

itemNotes.KUUDRA_TEETH: Infernal tier now rewards 3 Kuudra Teeth, and tiers 3 and 4 now reward 2 each.

patches.title: [November 30] SkyBlock Patch Notes
patches.summary: Pre-update that alters zone messages, Snow Blaster fire rate and gift loot tables, and adds new Sea Creatures. New content such as the Advent Calendar is staged to activate on December 1.

patches.title: [November 23] SkyBlock Patch Notes
patches.summary: Removes the AFK buff from the Legion enchantment and caps Slayer quest XP from each mob at 50% of the boss spawn cost. Also redesigns the Thunderlord and Thunderbolt items so they are usable again.

patches.title: [November 21] SkyBlock Patch Notes
patches.summary: Fixes a bug that caused negative collection amounts, several Block Zapper issues (it now works with sacks and the Personal Deletor), and adds owner holograms above Slayer bosses.

patches.title: [November 15] SkyBlock Patch Notes
patches.summary: Fixes minions spawning mobs in odd spots when the island boots, and fixes the Trapper Crest not upgrading correctly when recombobulated.

patches.title: SkyBlock Patch 0.16.1 - Spider's Den QoL, new mayor and more!
patches.summary: Makes Arachne, her Brood and Keepers much easier and adds Arachne's Armor and the Arack sword. Thunderstorms in the Spider's Den now drop Poison Samples, and Finnegan becomes a new Mayor.

itemNotes.ARACHNE_FANG: Dropped by Arachne; used with 8 others to craft the Vaccine Ring.
itemNotes.ESSENCE_SPIDER: Beating Arachne now grants 8 and 30 Spider Essence, per the two fight variants in the patch.
itemNotes.POISON_SAMPLE: Dropped by Toxic Slimes during Spider's Den Thunderstorms; 8 are used to craft the Vaccine Artifact.

patches.title: SkyBlock Patch 0.16 - Kuudra Revamp, End Island QoL, Bits items and more!
patches.summary: Overhauls the Kuudra fight with routes, a wave system and three phases, and reworks the End Island with new armor drops, the Draconic Altar and Ender Nodes. Several water orb and Ichthyic recipes are made cheaper, and Bits items and Abiphone contacts are added.

itemNotes.MITE_GEL: Now drops from Endermite Nests in the reworked Ender Nodes, a new supply source.
itemNotes.SHARK_WATER_ORB: Recipe reduced to 8 Blue Shark Teeth (was 16), 16 Nurse Shark Teeth (was 32) and 12 Enchanted Shark Fins (was 16).
itemNotes.WATER_ORB: Recipe now needs 16 Enchanted Prismarine Crystals (was 0) and 16 Enchanted Prismarine Shards (was 32).
itemNotes.WINTER_WATER_ORB: Recipe now needs 32 Hunks of Blue Ice (was 16) and 16 Green Gifts (was 8), so more ice and gift demand.

patches.title: SkyBlock Patch 0.15 - Leveling, Balancing, and more!
patches.summary: Introduces SkyBlock Levels with stat boosts and unlocks, adds the Croesus NPC for Dungeon chests, and rebalances many weapons, pets and power stones. Kat's Zombie pet recipe now uses Enchanted Rotten Flesh.

itemNotes.ENCHANTED_ROTTEN_FLESH: Kat's Zombie pet recipe now uses 8 stacks of this instead of 8 Zombie Hearts.
itemNotes.FURBALL: Power stone drop rate raised from 0.82% to 1.5%.
itemNotes.LUXURIOUS_SPOOL: Now drops 100% from killing Arachne and only 5% from the Brood Mother, previously 100% from the Brood Mother.

patches.title: [September 15] Temporary Minion Simulation Patch
patches.summary: Temporarily cuts the offline minion action cap from 100k to 14k while login-time simulation is slow. Offline resource caps drop much sooner until the simulation is optimized, and a later update removed the cap.

patches.title: [September 11] Profile Actions Cooldown
patches.summary: Adds a shared 90-second cooldown across creating, deleting and switching SkyBlock profiles, and deploys a recipe change for Gabagool. The post does not say which Gabagool variant changed.

patches.title: [September 8] Test Of Control - SkyBlock Dojo Challenge
patches.summary: Adds the Test of Control, a gaze-tracking Dojo challenge with a leaderboard. Also fixes slime blocks not compacting, Crystal Hunter commissions overlapping, and several Kuudra pet and Lonesome Miner issues.

patches.title: [September 6] Moby's Fishing Speed Chumpdate
patches.summary: Adds Moby, a Mushroom Desert NPC who trades six new fishing items for Chum Buckets that players fill together. Also adds Bobbin' Time and Piscary enchants and reworks the Ammonite pet to restore fishing speed.

itemNotes.BOBBIN_SCRIPTURES: New rare drop from Yetis, Grim Reapers, Sea Emperors and Lord Jawbus; crafts the Bobbin' Time ultimate enchant.
itemNotes.CHUM: New fishing item that players gather to fill Chum Buckets for Moby trades. Adds a new demand source for Chum.
itemNotes.ENCHANTMENT_PISCARY_*: Piscary is unlocked for fishing rods at Enchanting level 8. Piscary VI can rarely appear in the Experimentation Table.
itemNotes.PITCHIN_KOI: Lava Leeches now rarely drop it, giving a new source for the Pitchin' reforge stone.

patches.title: [August 27] Maddox is Mad
patches.summary: Cuts how much %HP damage Slayers deal to allied summoned mobs within 12 blocks, and the Seraph now recalls summons when hitshield breaks. Adds a mana cost to souls on the Summoning Ring.

patches.title: [August 27] Patch 0.14 Bug Fixes 3, Trilogy Complete
patches.summary: Fixes the Lazy Miner and Rare Relics quests, plus a /visit performance issue. Booster Cookies now grant +25 Wisdom, Scatha's Wormhole no longer breaks every block, and Salmon, Pufferfish and Clownfish join the Fishing Bag.

patches.title: [August 23] Patch 0.14 Bug Fixes 2
patches.summary: Second 0.14 hotfix batch: raises the Dungeons speed overflow limit, fixes stat cap calculations and Overload, and repairs the Auto-Recombobulator. Also fixes drills that kept their innate stats when out of fuel.

patches.title: [August 19] Patch 0.14 Bug Fixes
patches.summary: Fixes a batch of 0.14 issues, including egg and Stranded duplication exploits, a Catacombs level bypass for Essence trading, and missing or unobtainable enchants in the Bazaar. Jerry's Lost and Found now returns Essence lost in the Bazaar.

patches.title: SkyBlock Patch 0.14 - Shen's Auctions, The Hex, RNG Meter and more!
patches.summary: Adds the Hex for applying item modifiers from one menu, an RNG Meter for Catacombs and Slayers, Shen's Auction and a stats breakdown menu. Also opens every Essence type and enchant books to the Bazaar, and rebalances many enchants, Enderman Slayer tiers and pets.

itemNotes.ESSENCE_CRIMSON: Every Essence type became tradeable on the Bazaar in this update, adding new supply and demand.
itemNotes.ESSENCE_DIAMOND: Every Essence type became tradeable on the Bazaar in this update, adding new supply and demand.
itemNotes.ESSENCE_DRAGON: Every Essence type became tradeable on the Bazaar in this update, adding new supply and demand.
itemNotes.ESSENCE_FOREST: Every Essence type became tradeable on the Bazaar in this update, adding new supply and demand.
itemNotes.ESSENCE_FOSSIL: Every Essence type became tradeable on the Bazaar in this update, adding new supply and demand.
itemNotes.ESSENCE_GOLD: Every Essence type became tradeable on the Bazaar in this update, adding new supply and demand.
itemNotes.ESSENCE_ICE: Every Essence type became tradeable on the Bazaar in this update, adding new supply and demand.
itemNotes.ESSENCE_SAFARI: Every Essence type became tradeable on the Bazaar in this update, adding new supply and demand.
itemNotes.ESSENCE_SPIDER: Every Essence type became tradeable on the Bazaar in this update, adding new supply and demand.
itemNotes.ESSENCE_UNDEAD: Every Essence type became tradeable on the Bazaar in this update, adding new supply and demand.
itemNotes.ESSENCE_WITHER: Every Essence type became tradeable on the Bazaar in this update, adding new supply and demand.
itemNotes.MITHRIL_ORE: NPC sell price lowered from 10 to 8 coins.

patches.title: [August 5] Chili Pepper Update
patches.summary: Adds the Chili Pepper Combat collection, which drops from Inferno Minions running Hypergolic fuel, and makes Hypergolic fuel less random. Kelvin Inverter gets a 100k NPC price, and Blaze Slayer and Sorrow armor get tweaks.

itemNotes.CHILI_PEPPER: New collection item. Inferno Minions on Hypergolic fuel drop roughly 5 to 30 per minion per day, adding a new supply stream.
itemNotes.HYPERGOLIC_GABAGOOL: Unique drop rate from Hypergolic fuel raised by 10%, which should increase Hypergolic Gabagool supply.
itemNotes.HYPERGOLIC_IONIZED_CERAMICS: Expired Hypergolic fuel now always drops one, so each expired fuel yields a Ceramic. Eight make an Inferno Vertex.
itemNotes.INFERNO_VERTEX: Crafted from eight Hypergolic Ionized Ceramics, which now drop reliably from expired Hypergolic fuel.
itemNotes.SULPHURIC_COAL: Alternate recipe unlocked at Chili Pepper II, intended to lower the cost of Hypergolic Gabagool.

patches.title: [August 1] Thunder Revolution Update, QoL, and Bug Fixes
patches.summary: Reworks how the Empty Thunder Bottle is charged, with sparks dropping from the Thunder boss. Also adds auto-pickup for miniboss loot, Pulse Ring perks, Slayer Sack items and several Ashfang and Matriarch fixes.

patches.title: [July 28] Auction House Maximum Bid Limit Increase
patches.summary: Raises the Auction House maximum bid from about 2.1 billion to 10 billion by removing the old 32-bit integer limit.

patches.title: [July 27] Bug fixes
patches.summary: Bug-fix batch from a new developer: full-inventory Summoning Eye drops go to your stash, Blessing rod drops fixed, NPC shop daily limit bypass patched, and Pickobulus no longer breaks portals.

patches.title: [June 22] Recent Bug Fixes
patches.summary: Large cumulative batch of June bug fixes, including Redstone always giving its Crystal Hollows bonus drops, Refined reforge drop corrections and consistent Sulphur and Corrupted Fragment minion output. Also raises the Teleport Pad cap to 28.

itemNotes.CORRUPTED_FRAGMENT: Minion output of Corrupted Fragments is now consistent.
itemNotes.ENCHANTED_INK_SACK: Refined reforge no longer grants Enchanted Ink Sacs when mining Lapis.
itemNotes.ENCHANTED_MITHRIL: Refined reforge now correctly drops Enchanted Mithril when mining Mithril.
itemNotes.REDSTONE: Crystal Hollows Redstone now always gives its extra drops instead of sometimes skipping them.
itemNotes.SULPHUR_ORE: Minion output of Sulphur is now consistent.

patches.title: Changes to Cake Souls and Spooky Pies
patches.summary: Captured Cake Souls and Spooky Pies become co-op soulbound, and Cake Souls now show only capture details. Aims to curb boosting and coin-selling abuse.

patches.title: [May 16] Various SkyBlock Bug fixes
patches.summary: Fixes crashes with Thunderlord and Gauntlet of Contagion, Pickonimbus durability, stranded kill tracking and several carpentry and minion issues, plus a batch of typo fixes.

patches.title: [May 11] Sunshade Patch
patches.summary: Adds Infinite Spirit Leap at Malik for 25k Wither Essence and a Sunshade drop from Blazes. Sulphuric Coal needs 4x less Sulphur, and Millennia-Old Blaze Ashes drop far more often.

itemNotes.ESSENCE_WITHER: Malik now sells Infinite Spirit Leap for 25k Wither Essence, a new sink for this Essence.
itemNotes.MILLENIA_OLD_BLAZE_ASHES: Drops much more frequently from Millennia-Old Blazes, increasing supply.
itemNotes.SULPHURIC_COAL: Recipe now uses 4x less Sulphur, which cuts its input cost.

patches.title: [May 4] Crimson Isle Achievements and Bug Fixes
patches.summary: Adds 11 named Crimson Isle achievements, including Dojo, faction, Kuudra and miniboss milestones, plus Crimson Isle bug fixes. Achievements are retroactive for players who already met them.

patches.title: [April 29] Crimson Isle Weeks 1 & 2
patches.summary: Collects fixes from the first two weeks after the Crimson Isle release, covering Kuudra, Dojo, Trophy Fishing and minions. Also fireproofs island items, adds Bazaar baits and adds Maxwell and Jacobus to Stranded.

itemNotes.COAL: Auto Smelt now produces Coal from more log types.
itemNotes.MYCEL: Mycelium minions now need only one co-op member to meet the reputation requirement, making them easier to run.
itemNotes.SAND:1: Red Sand minions now need only one co-op member to meet the reputation requirement, making them easier to run.

patches.title: [April 25] Rusty Unleashed
patches.summary: Replaces the Telekinesis enchant with an auto-pickup perk and adds Rusty's shop plus a material stash. Also lowers Corrupt Bait and Corrupted Fragment values and turns Eccentric Painting into a bundle.

itemNotes.CORRUPTED_BAIT: Corrupt Bait NPC sell price cut to 1 coin.
itemNotes.CORRUPTED_FRAGMENT: Value changed from 500 to 20, likely its NPC sell price, which sharply reduces what it is worth to NPCs.
itemNotes.ECCENTRIC_PAINTING: Now a bundle that opens into nine Power Stones in the Dark Auction.

patches.title: [April 21] Crimson Isle - The Fixes
patches.summary: Crimson Isle fix list covering Farming Islands zones, Dwarven Mines raffle timing, Trophy Fishing and Bookshelf issues. Also adds Mining Fortune to cobblestone, gravel, glowstone and obsidian.

itemNotes.COBBLESTONE: Mining Fortune now applies to this block, so it yields more when mined with Fortune.
itemNotes.GLOWSTONE_DUST: Glowstone now benefits from Mining Fortune, raising yields when mined with Fortune.
itemNotes.GRAVEL: Mining Fortune now applies to this block, so it yields more when mined with Fortune.
itemNotes.OBSIDIAN: Mining Fortune now applies to this block, so it yields more when mined with Fortune.

patches.title: SkyBlock Patch 0.13 - Crimson Isle
patches.summary: Releases the Crimson Isle with two factions, Kuudra, new armors, Blaze Slayer, Trophy Fishing and Attributes. Also adds Crimson, Sulphur, Mycelium, Red Sand and Magmafish collections and reworks Accessory Bag stats.

itemNotes.ESSENCE_CRIMSON: New Essence from bosses and salvaged Nether gear, needed to star some Crimson Isle armor past five stars.
itemNotes.HEAVY_PEARL: Only obtainable from the Matriarch, which yields just three per real day.
itemNotes.MAGMA_FISH: New Magmafish collection, obtained through Lava Fishing.
itemNotes.MYCEL: New source: obtainable in the Mystic Marsh near Scarleton.
itemNotes.SAND:1: Can now be shoveled from the Burning Desert, a new supply source.
itemNotes.SULPHUR_ORE: New material from Volcano eruptions and corrupted mobs, adding a new Sulphur supply.

patches.title: [April 18] QoL Bug Fixes
patches.summary: Mostly message and text fixes covering grammar, typos, chat colors and Auction House wording. Also lowers the VIP requirement for the Carpenter NPC and adds kill tracking to the Fel Sword lore.

patches.title: [April 1] Tool Reforges Patch
patches.summary: Adds a new set of tool reforges from the Blacksmith and shows reforge passives on Reforge Stones. Also includes small fixes to the Quiver, Personal Bank and Dark Auction, and disables Mooshroom stew from shears.

patches.title: [March 31] The SkyBlock Wiki In-Game
patches.summary: Adds Biblio, a Hub NPC who promotes the in-game SkyBlock Wiki, and three commands: /wiki, /wiki <id> and /wikithis.

patches.title: Official Hypixel SkyBlock Wiki Released!
patches.summary: Announces the official Hypixel SkyBlock Wiki, a Hypixel-led, community-maintained site covering collections, dragons, dungeons, pets and locations. It is in beta and English only.

patches.title: [March 8th] Small Dungeons Patch
patches.summary: Tunes Floor 7 and Master Mode 7 boss fights, raises M7 rewards and removes the Dark Claymore mining fatigue. Also fixes a range of dungeon bugs, including knockback immunity and Dragon statue spawns.

patches.title: [0.12.3] Master Mode 7
patches.summary: Releases Master Mode 7 and reworks Floor 7, bringing back three bosses that were cut earlier. Also adds rare custom dyes and cosmetic Catacombs levels above 50.

patches.title: [February 14] Stranded Small Patch
patches.summary: Adds a Smithmonger NPC for reforge stones, a last-resort Water Bucket trade and Lava Bucket trade, and a higher mob cap. Also updates the Nether revamp alpha plan.

patches.title: [February 7] Some Bug Fixes
patches.summary: Adds an Entity Limiter to private islands and skill XP values for several minion items. Also fixes Skeletal Defense procs, Showcase Block stacking and a drill duplication issue.

patches.title: [February 2nd] Balancing Patch
patches.summary: Big balance pass: One For All becomes additive, many enchants are buffed, and several pets are reworked. Scatha becomes an upgradable pet that consumes Enchanted Hard Stone.

itemNotes.ENCHANTED_HARD_STONE: New demand from Scatha pet upgrades: 64 for Rare to Epic and 256 for Epic to Legendary.
itemNotes.NETHER_STALK: Sell price cut from 3 to 2, lowering its NPC value.

patches.title: SkyBlock Stranded
patches.summary: Adds SkyBlock Stranded, an Ironman-like mode where you never leave your own island but can still unlock most collections.

patches.title: [January 13] Armadillo, Double Jump, and more fixes!
patches.summary: Fixes Armadillo energy and Gemstone breaking, and reworks Double Jump boots to use the sneak key. Also reworks the internal pet system and lets the Bazaar price box accept suffixes like 12k.

patches.title: [December 17] Some Dungeon QoL
patches.summary: Reworks Catacombs scoring so each floor needs a smaller share of secrets for full score, with extra secrets paying bonus EXP. The first five clears of each floor also get the first-clear EXP bonus, and speed targets were raised.

patches.title: [December 16] Some more bug fixes
patches.summary: Bug-fix batch covering island out-of-bounds teleports, trade lag detection, enchant fixes and Crystal Hollows nucleus exploits. Adds a Physics Limiter on private islands that caps falling sand, cane and cactus to ease server lag.

patches.title: SkyBlock Bingo Events
patches.summary: Introduces Bingo, a temporary monthly game mode with 25 goals, Bingo Points and a rewards shop. Bingo profiles have no trading, Bazaar or Auction House access and are deleted at the end of the event.

patches.title: [November 8] Bugs, QOL, and more Bugs.
patches.summary: A week of bug fixes and QoL changes: new warp aliases, longer Crystal Hollows instances, sack reshuffles and several exploit fixes. Several items were also added to the Bazaar, including goblin eggs and Worm Membrane.

itemNotes.ARACHNE_KEEPER_FRAGMENT: Arachne's Keeper Fragment was added to the Bazaar.
itemNotes.CHEESE_FUEL: Cheese was added to the Bazaar as a new category item.
itemNotes.GOBLIN_EGG: All goblin egg variants were added to the Bazaar.
itemNotes.GOBLIN_EGG_BLUE: All goblin egg variants were added to the Bazaar.
itemNotes.GOBLIN_EGG_GREEN: All goblin egg variants were added to the Bazaar.
itemNotes.GOBLIN_EGG_RED: All goblin egg variants were added to the Bazaar.
itemNotes.GOBLIN_EGG_YELLOW: All goblin egg variants were added to the Bazaar.
itemNotes.HARD_STONE: New source: Diorite, Granite and Andesite in the Crystal Hollows now yield Hard Stone.
itemNotes.RAW_SOULFLOW: An exploit that produced infinite Raw Soulflow from minions was fixed, which reduces supply.
itemNotes.SOUL_STRING: Newly added to the Bazaar as its own category item.
itemNotes.SUPERBOOM_TNT: The Crystal Hollows Chunk NPC now sells Superboom TNT, giving it an NPC supply source.

patches.title: SkyBlock Patch 0.12.1 - The Museum
patches.summary: Adds the Museum in the Hub, where donated weapons, armor and rarities earn ranks and bank upgrades. Donated items become soulbound or co-op soulbound, which removes them from the market and acts as an item sink.

patches.title: [November 2nd] Rune removal and bugfixes
patches.summary: Adds free Rune Removal at the Rune Pedestal, which destroys the attached rune. Also raises the collection cap to 9 quintillion and fixes several ability and defense bugs.

patches.title: [October 20] Crystal Hollows Achievements & Dungeon Finder Settings
patches.summary: Adds Crystal Hollows achievements and Dungeon Finder filters for class and dungeon level, plus group sorting. Also fixes recombobulators on arrows, the Hollows boss record message and a /warp case issue.

patches.title: [October 13] Some QOL and fixes!
patches.summary: Makes custom Mushroom Soups stack properly and removes nausea from them. Adds a global cap on Bat Fireworks and fixes Booster Cookie flight, dupe-detection gaps and a menu flicker.

patches.title: [October 4] Reforge by accessory rarity + more
patches.summary: Adds rarity filtering for accessory bag reforging, reforge stone previews and the Nether Artifact in the Dark Auction. Also fixes Last Stand, Gloomlock debuff timing and several damage-reduction talisman stacking bugs.

patches.title: [September 23] Super-Tiny Patch
patches.summary: Small patch: a Fast Travel Scroll for the Void Sepulture, Voidling bestiary entries, gifted-coin tracking on Byron's Compassion, and autopet rules for slayer bosses and Catacombs floors.

patches.title: [September 13th] Crystal Hollows Patch
patches.summary: Crystal Hollows rebalance: Gemstone NPC sell prices cut sharply, gemstone slot unlocks added, and Crystal Nucleus rewards expanded. The Gemstone Mixture recipe was changed to use less Sludge Juice and more gems.

itemNotes.GEMSTONE_MIXTURE: Recipe now needs 320 Sludge Juice (was 500) and 4 Fine gems per type (was 2), so it uses less Sludge Juice per craft.
itemNotes.JADERALD: Crystal Nucleus changes make it about 50% more common, which raises supply.
itemNotes.SLUDGE_JUICE: Gemstone Mixture now needs 320 instead of 500, and the Jungle Pickaxe drops it at 3% chance instead of 1 per proc, which lowers demand.

patches.title: [September 7th] Weaponsmith City Project
patches.summary: Adds the Weaponsmith City Project to the Village, with Rosetta's early gear, Jax's special arrows, and a Target Practice minigame that gates the higher arrow tiers. Infinite Quiver X was nerfed to save arrows 30% of the time.

itemNotes.ENCHANTMENT_INFINITE_QUIVER_10: Infinite Quiver X was nerfed to a 30% chance to save arrows, so the book is less valuable for arrow users.

patches.title: [August 24th] Small Skyblock Bug Fixes + New Dungeon Rooms
patches.summary: Small bug-fix patch fixing the mushroom desert objective and the Bountiful reforge crop bonus. Adds many missing Super Compactor recipes and new dungeon rooms, plus a Crystal Hollows background track.

patches.title: [August 13] Item Drops + Tiny Patch
patches.summary: Stops players from dropping items on non-coop members to curb boosting and IRL trading. Also makes Jacob's items tradeable, updates Rend's damage rules, and lets several items be sold to NPCs.

itemNotes.ASCENSION_ROPE: Can now be sold to NPCs, which adds an NPC sell option for this item.
itemNotes.SUPERBOOM_TNT: Can now be sold to NPCs, which adds an NPC sell option for this item.
itemNotes.WISHING_COMPASS: Can now be sold to NPCs, which adds an NPC sell option for this item.

patches.title: [July 27] Crystal Hollows Week Two Patch
patches.summary: Second Crystal Hollows patch with Efficient Miner and Mole fixes, a new Ammonite pet, and five-minute spawn protection at entrances. Sludge Juice and Yoggies were added to the Bazaar under a new Slime Drops category.

itemNotes.SLUDGE_JUICE: Now tradeable on the Bazaar (new Slime Drops category), giving it a market price.
itemNotes.YOGGIE: Now tradeable on the Bazaar (new Slime Drops category).

patches.title: [July 20] Crystal Hollows Week One Patch
patches.summary: First Crystal Hollows patch with fixes to Braum and Mole unlocks, loot chests and the Bal boss, plus more Gemstone Grinder items. Removes the Ruby skull matching room.

patches.title: SkyBlock Patch 0.12 - Crystal Hollows
patches.summary: Launches the Crystal Hollows, a gemstone mining zone with a paid minecart entry, a Crystal Nucleus and two new Heart of the Mountain levels. Adds Hard Stone and Gemstone collections plus the Gemstone Grinder.

patches.title: [July 13] Weaponsmith Workshop City Project (Started)
patches.summary: Announces the Weaponsmith Workshop city project in the community shop, which can be explored on the Alpha Network.

patches.title: [June 1] Inventory Items Patch
patches.summary: Several storage items return (Basket of Seeds, Builders Wand, Nether Wart Pouch, New Year Cake Bag, Trick or Treat Bag) after a rewrite aimed at stopping dupes and exploits.

patches.title: SkyBlock 0.11.5
patches.summary: Adds the Voidgloom Seraph Enderman slayer, the Void Sepulture zone, and Soulflow as a new resource that feeds item abilities. Also changes slayer pricing and lowers the NPC sell prices of Obsidian and Ender Pearl.

itemNotes.ENDER_PEARL: NPC sell price lowered from 10 to 7.
itemNotes.OBSIDIAN: NPC sell price lowered from 12 to 9.
itemNotes.SOULFLOW: New resource from slayer drops that is consumed by item abilities, adding a new demand sink.

patches.title: [April 30] Farming Island Follow-up Patch
patches.summary: Follow-up to the 0.11.4 Farming Islands revamp, adding Master Stars and Master Skulls drops and cutting Master Floor 5 EXP. Also shortens Trevor's cooldown and fixes a large batch of build, collection and Builder's Wand bugs.

patches.title: SkyBlock 0.11.4
patches.summary: Revamps the Farming Islands, adds Master Mode Floor 6 and the Winter Sack, and cleans up the Bazaar by merging several material pairs. Also adds fuels, enchanted Netherrack and Treasurite to the Dwarven material group.

itemNotes.BROWN_MUSHROOM: Merged with Red Mushroom into one Bazaar category, and also added to the agronomy sack.
itemNotes.ENCHANTED_NETHERRACK: Enchanted Netherrack was added to the game, with Magical Lava Buckets as a crafting route.
itemNotes.FLINT: Merged with Gravel into one Bazaar category, which changes how its listing is grouped.
itemNotes.GRAVEL: Merged with Flint into one Bazaar category.
itemNotes.MAGMA_BUCKET: Added to the Fuels category in the Bazaar.
itemNotes.PLASMA_BUCKET: Added to the Fuels category in the Bazaar.
itemNotes.POWER_CRYSTAL: Added to the Fuels category in the Bazaar.
itemNotes.RED_MUSHROOM: Merged with Brown Mushroom into one Bazaar category.
itemNotes.SEEDS: Merged with Wheat into one Bazaar category.
itemNotes.TREASURITE: Added to the Dwarven Materials group in the Bazaar.
itemNotes.WHEAT: Merged with Seeds into one Bazaar category.

patches.title: [April 20] Backpacks Revamp
patches.summary: Replaces the old backpacks with Storage, an expanded Ender Chest that can equip up to 18 backpacks. Legacy backpacks convert into it, and Jumbo Backpacks lose a row to make room for the menu.

patches.title: SkyBlock 0.11.3
patches.summary: Opens Master Mode floors 1 to 5 and rebalances Dungeon classes, weapons, bosses and healing. Lifesteal and Syphon are reworked and boss damage gets soft caps. Upgrade costs for many dungeon items are reduced.

itemNotes.ESSENCE_DIAMOND: Hardened Diamond Armor upgrade cost was reduced to 5 to 25 per star.
itemNotes.ESSENCE_DRAGON: Dragon armor and Aspect of the Dragons essence upgrade costs were reduced, lowering demand.
itemNotes.ESSENCE_GOLD: Midas Sword, Midas Staff and Rogue Sword upgrade costs were reduced.
itemNotes.ESSENCE_ICE: Yeti Sword upgrade cost was reduced to 100 to 300 Ice Essence per star.
itemNotes.ESSENCE_SPIDER: Upgrade costs for spider weapons, bows and boots were reduced, lowering demand.
itemNotes.ESSENCE_UNDEAD: Upgrade costs for several undead weapons and masks were reduced, lowering demand.
itemNotes.ESSENCE_WITHER: Soul Whip upgrade cost was reduced to 200 to 600 Wither Essence per star.

patches.title: [March 12th] Bartender's Brewery Update
patches.summary: Adds Revenant Tier V slayer with new drops and recipes, plus Auto-Slayer and RNGesus meters. Also reworks god potions with Mixins and adds NPC sell prices for Revenant Flesh and catalysts.

itemNotes.REVENANT_FLESH: Gained an NPC sell price, giving it a fixed floor value.

patches.title: SkyBlock 0.11.2
patches.summary: Revamps the Spider's Den, adds the Bestiary, Grandma Wolf's combo pet and the Personal Deletor. Also adds Enchanted Sacks for first-tier enchanted items and a batch of QoL and balance fixes.

patches.title: [February 19] Tiny patch
patches.summary: Tiny patch adding autopet rules for fishing hooks and island exceptions, plus a short cooldown between rule swaps. Also fixes Foraging Fortune on some logs and several server crashes.

patches.title: SkyBlock 0.11.1
patches.summary: Adds Bits Shop items such as the Pets Auto-Equipper and Block Zapper, along with Farming XP buffs and a long list of bug fixes. Enchanted Cactus and Enchanted Cooked Cod are now accepted by the Super Compactor 3000.

itemNotes.ENCHANTED_CACTUS: Accepted by the Super Compactor 3000, which adds a compacting route for this item.
itemNotes.ENCHANTED_COOKED_FISH: Accepted by the Super Compactor 3000, which adds a compacting route for this item.

patches.title: [February 5] Elephants! (Farming fix)
patches.summary: Buffs the Elephant pet's farming yields after it was moved to Farming Fortune and lost value. The post explains the history of farming yield changes and says newer players will benefit most.

patches.title: [January 26] Dwarven Mines Hotfix #3
patches.summary: Hotfix for the Dwarven Mines covering mining fatigue, the Mine Affinity talisman, a salmon armor exploit and refined Titanium pickaxe enchants. Adds Enchanted Mithril and Enchanted Titanium to the Bazaar.

itemNotes.ENCHANTED_MITHRIL: Added to the Bazaar, which gives it a market price.
itemNotes.ENCHANTED_TITANIUM: Added to the Bazaar, which gives it a market price.

patches.title: [January 20] Dwarven Mines Hotfix #2
patches.summary: Second Dwarven Mines hotfix that removes mining speed from the King Talisman, changes Compact to a percentage proc, and adds Heart of the Mountain tweaks and a /hotm command.

patches.title: [January 16] Dwarven Mines Hotfix #1
patches.summary: First Dwarven Mines hotfix that disables the custom mining tech on some islands, including private islands. Also restores farming yields that were hit by the new Fortune stats.

patches.title: SkyBlock Patch 0.11 - Dwarven Mines
patches.summary: Launches the Dwarven Mines, a mining layer with Mithril, Heart of the Mountain, Commissions, the Forge and Beacons. Also reworks mining with custom mining tech and adds Mining Fortune stats.

patches.title: [December 7] Guesting Changes
patches.summary: Guesting hotfixes: blocks item use in island parkour, closes a social-skill requirement bypass, and adds an island browser to the fast travel menu.

patches.title: [December 4] Enchanting Update Day-One Patch
patches.summary: Day-one follow-up to the Enchanting update: lowers level requirements for top enchants, raises the daily non-experiment enchanting XP cap from 50k to 500k, and lets players replay experiments up to four times a day.

patches.title: SkyBlock Enchanting Mega-Overhaul
patches.summary: Overhauls Enchanting: the table lets players pick enchants gated by skill level and bookshelf power, enchanted books combine for free, and seven new enchantments arrive. Experiments add large daily XP.

itemNotes.ENCHANTMENT_CHANCE_*: New bow enchant: +15% to +75% monster drop chance. Unlocked at Enchanting 11.
itemNotes.ENCHANTMENT_FIRE_ASPECT_*: Reworked: now burns for 100% of weapon damage each second, but hits no longer ignite targets.
itemNotes.ENCHANTMENT_FIRE_PROTECTION_*: Buffed: +4 to +60 defense per level, plus +2 true defense vs fire and lava.
itemNotes.ENCHANTMENT_PROSECUTE_*: New sword enchant: damage scales with the target's health, capped at 35%. Unlocked at Enchanting 25.
itemNotes.ENCHANTMENT_RESPITE_*: New armor enchant: +5% to +25% natural regen out of combat. Unlocked at Enchanting 23.
itemNotes.ENCHANTMENT_SYPHON_*: New sword enchant: heals 0.2% to 0.5% of damage dealt on crits. Unlocked at Enchanting 15.
itemNotes.ENCHANTMENT_THUNDERBOLT_*: New sword enchant: lightning strikes nearby mobs every third hit. Unlocked at Enchanting 20.
itemNotes.ENCHANTMENT_THUNDERLORD_*: Buffed: lightning scaling raised from 50% to 150% of Strength.
itemNotes.ENCHANTMENT_TITAN_KILLER_*: New sword enchant: +1% to +7% damage per 100 target defense, capped at 25%. Unlocked at Enchanting 28.
itemNotes.ENCHANTMENT_TRIPLE_STRIKE_*: New sword enchant: +10% to +50% melee damage on the first three hits. Unlocked at Enchanting 19.

patches.title: [December 3] Farming Patch
patches.summary: Adds farming tools such as the Fungi Cutter, Rancher's Boots and Personal Compactor 7000, and new Compactor and Super Compactor recipes for mushrooms, sugar, hay and pumpkins. Three items join the Bazaar.

itemNotes.ENCHANTED_HAY_BALE: Super Compactor now turns it into a Tightly-Tied Hay Bale.
itemNotes.ENCHANTED_HUGE_MUSHROOM_1: Output of the new Super Compactor recipe from Brown Mushroom Block.
itemNotes.ENCHANTED_HUGE_MUSHROOM_2: Output of the new Super Compactor recipe from Red Mushroom Block.
itemNotes.ENCHANTED_NETHER_STALK: Super Compactor now turns it into a Mutant Nether Wart.
itemNotes.ENCHANTED_PUMPKIN: Super Compactor now turns it into a Polished Pumpkin.
itemNotes.ENCHANTED_SUGAR: New Super Compactor recipe: converts into Enchanted Sugar Cane.
itemNotes.ENCHANTED_SUGAR_CANE: Output of the new Enchanted Sugar Super Compactor recipe.
itemNotes.HUGE_MUSHROOM_1: New Compactor recipe from Brown Mushroom. Super Compactor turns it into an Enchanted Brown Mushroom Block.
itemNotes.HUGE_MUSHROOM_2: New Compactor recipe from Red Mushroom. Super Compactor turns it into an Enchanted Red Mushroom Block.
itemNotes.INK_SACK:3: Coco Chopper now yields +20% cocoa bean drops.

patches.title: [November 29] Small SkyBlock patch
patches.summary: Small fishing patch: changes fishing level requirements for several rods and fishing armor sets, adds a cheaper but weaker Salmon Armor, and rebalances the Auger and Yeti Rods.

patches.title: [November 26] Bug Fixes & Some New Items!
patches.summary: Adds a Golem Hat, Sea Lantern Hat, Emerald Ring and a Salmon Armor set with a sneak-activated Water Burst ability, along with several bug fixes.

patches.title: [0.9.13] Catacombs Floor 7
patches.summary: Makes Catacombs Floor 7 a fight against Necron, with one extra chest unlocked per boss phase and the Obsidian chest unlocked by beating him. Floors 1 to 6 are slightly easier and the Reaper Mask is buffed.

patches.title: SkyBlock Patch 0.9.12 - Guesting Update
patches.summary: Adds the Social skill, Amelia's reward shop, and an island browser for guesting. Players can name islands, create ranks, build parkour courses, and add island NPCs and egg hunts.

patches.title: [0.9.11] City Project: Farm Merchant's Dwelling
patches.summary: Adds the Farmhouse with Jacob's Farming Contests, medals and tickets, and Anita's shop. Double-drop effects now stack additively, with the Elephant and Monkey pets rebalanced to match.

itemNotes.CACTUS: Added to the Farm Merchant NPC.
itemNotes.JACOBS_TICKET: Tradeable on the Bazaar under Oddities. Earned from Jacob's contests and spent on Anita's items.

patches.title: [0.9.10] Spooky Fishing
patches.summary: Adds five spooky sea creatures that appear during the Fear Mongerer event, each with unique drops. Spooky bait boosts fishing speed and spooky spawns, and fishing rods are rebalanced.

patches.title: SkyBlock 0.9.9 - Spooky Festival Update Halloween 2020
patches.summary: Adds Spooky Festival mobs, Trick-or-Treat chests that can drop extra candy or tricks, a Mega Bat that drops candy on hit, and five extra festival events.

patches.title: [0.9.8] City Project: Blacksmith Workspace + New Bits Shop items
patches.summary: Adds the Blacksmith Workspace and Smithmonger, who sells five reforge stones. Ferocity becomes a player stat, and temporary Scorpius Dark Auction items and three Bits shop items are introduced.

patches.title: [October 19] Pet Luck + Magic Find Fix
patches.summary: Fixes a bug where Magic Find gave negative pet luck, so higher Magic Find had been reducing pet drops. Pet drop rates may be adjusted in the coming weeks.

patches.title: [0.9.7] City Project: Builder's House
patches.summary: The community finished the Builder's House city project. It adds a Builder NPC with more blocks for sale and an upgraded Wool Weaver shop in the Hub.

patches.title: [0.9.6] Ironman Gamemode
patches.summary: Adds Ironman profiles, which disable the Auction House and Bazaar and block player trading except with co-op members. Ironman players get a name icon.

patches.title: SkyBlock Patch 0.9.5 - Player List, Item Frames, and Bug Fixes!
patches.summary: Repurposes the player list with party, server and global info columns and adds an item frame menu and /effects. Also fixes several dupe bugs and exploits involving auctions, wither skulls and placement.

patches.title: [0.9.4] Catacombs Floor 6
patches.summary: Adds Catacombs Floor 6 with boss Sadan, a new mob-summoning mechanic that copies captured mob stats, and general Dungeon fixes such as the Livid teleport and revive mana changes.

patches.title: [September 24] Livid Dagger patch
patches.summary: Rebalances Livid Daggers so their passive becomes double damage from behind plus +50 crit damage, and the throwing ability can crit. Also raises their chest cost and buffs Shadow Fury range.

patches.title: [0.9.3] Co-op improvements
patches.summary: Co-op improvements: each member gets a personal bank account and personal bank interest, minion EXP goes to every member, and a shared Vault is added along with co-op party and chat commands.

patches.title: [0.9.2] Community Shop Patch
patches.summary: Lets players contribute to City Projects multiple times per component on a daily cooldown. Bits gains from activities are raised, and several fire sales can run at once.

patches.title: [0.9.1] Catacombs Floor 5 and general changes
patches.summary: Adds Catacombs Floor 5 with Livid and a Bedrock chest for S+ runs, plus a new loot system that distributes drops among nearby players. Also fixes incorrect essence drop amounts.

itemNotes.ESSENCE_WITHER: Fixed essence drops giving the wrong amounts.

patches.title: [September 10] Elections Update Hotfix
patches.summary: Hotfixes the Election event after candidates lost their perks in the second vote, letting players switch votes. Also fixes the Legendary Griffin Upgrade Stone crafting recipe and eases Minos Hunters.

itemNotes.GRIFFIN_UPGRADE_STONE_LEGENDARY: Recipe layout changed so it no longer crafts an Epic stone.

patches.title: SkyBlock Patch 0.9 - Election Event & Community Shop
patches.summary: Introduces the yearly Mayor election, the Community Shop with City Projects, profile and account upgrades, Booster Cookies with a Bits shop, and FIRE sales for cosmetics.

itemNotes.BOOSTER_COOKIE: Bought with Gems in the Community Shop and also tradeable on the Bazaar. Each cookie adds 4 days of buff time.

patches.title: [August 21] Skill / Collection Rankings Reset
patches.summary: Changes the backend for skill and collection rankings: exact positions below 25k collection or level 15 skill are no longer stored. Rankings were reset, so positions may look odd for a few days.

patches.title: [August 19] Even More Bug Fixes!
patches.summary: A broad bug fix pass: the Magma Bow passive now deals double damage, Smelting Touch works on more tools, and several dupe bugs with saplings and apples are fixed.

patches.title: [0.8.1] Revamped Hub!
patches.summary: Revamps the SkyBlock Hub, moving NPCs into grouped areas such as Blacksmith with Enchanting, and Auction House, Bazaar and Bank together.

patches.title: [August 7] Dungeon Patch - Essence shop, balancing and more
patches.summary: Adds the Essence Shop, which sells items and perks for Undead and Wither Essence. Also adds Catacombs level filters to the Party Finder, reverts the mana regen change, and rebalances classes and dungeon magic resistance.

itemNotes.ESSENCE_UNDEAD: Now spendable in the new Essence Shop.
itemNotes.ESSENCE_WITHER: Now spendable in the new Essence Shop.

patches.title: [August 5] Colosseum Disabled
patches.summary: Temporarily disables the Colosseum in the Hub while its mechanics are reworked, which should also help performance in crowded lobbies.

patches.title: [July 30] Floor 4 and other changes
patches.summary: Adds Catacombs Floor 4 with boss Thorn, large changes to magic item damage and Dungeon mana regeneration, and an aggro system overhaul. Follow-up edits fix the magic damage formula and tune balance.

itemNotes.ESSENCE_ICE: New Ice Essence added as a Dungeon drop. Frozen Adventurers drop one extra.

patches.title: [July 30] MORE Achievements & Bug Fixes!
patches.summary: Adds a large batch of achievements, including Dungeon, pet and Recombobulator goals, plus bug fixes for the Dungeon party UI, Brewing, and door drops.

patches.title: [July 17] Dungeon QOL, Trades Changes, Other Stuff
patches.summary: Dungeon container limits and a secret counter, expanded trade menu with billion-coin trades, and fixes for AFK exploits that gave skill or guild XP.

patches.title: [July 16] Dungeon Queue
patches.summary: Adds a Dungeon queue that activates only when capacity is full, with party notifications and queue status in the sidebar.

patches.title: [July 15] Archer fixes
patches.summary: Archer fixes: in Dungeons, arrows now bypass mob invulnerability frames, and Archer ultimate arrows gain the Aiming enchant. Also fixes XP granted when milestones are missed.

patches.title: [July 14] More Dungeon changelogs
patches.summary: Adds Dungeon Boss Collections, retroactive for past boss kills, and rebalances Pigman, Frozen Scythe and Adaptive gear. Berserk healing and melee are buffed and the Tank ultimate cooldown is reduced.

patches.title: [July 10] Dungeon Changelogs
patches.summary: Dungeon tweaks: Reaper baby zombies are slower, revives now heal max HP, blessings scale with current stats, and the Gilded reforge gains stats and a passive.

patches.title: SkyBlock Patch 0.8 - First Dungeon: The Catacombs
patches.summary: Launches Dungeons with the Catacombs: a Dungeon Hub, Party Finder, blessings, a score system, Dungeon gear upgraded with essence, and five classes. Entry is limited to higher ranks at launch.

itemNotes.ESSENCE_UNDEAD: Dropped in Dungeons and used to convert gear into Dungeon items and upgrade them.
itemNotes.ESSENCE_WITHER: Dropped in Dungeons and used to convert gear into Dungeon items and upgrade them.

patches.title: [July 3] Random Damage Hotfix
patches.summary: Hotfix for random damage: Fabled no longer applies to every weapon on crit, Dark Goggles bonus is limited to the correct targets, and ability scaling is fixed for weapons with built-in intelligence.

patches.title: SkyBlock Patch 0.7.11 - Reforges
patches.summary: Reworks reforges: weapon and armor reforges get stronger, accessory reforges weaker, and Reforge Stones with drop sources are added. Attack Speed starts working, and the Dungeon Hub opens.

itemNotes.BEATING_HEART: Rare drop from living mobs in The Catacombs.
itemNotes.DIAMOND_ATOM: 1% drop from Angry Archeologists in Dungeons.
itemNotes.DRAGON_CLAW: New rare drop from every dragon, as rare as the Aspect of the Dragons.
itemNotes.DRAGON_HORN: Dropped only by Superior Dragons, replacing their Aspect of the Dragon drops.
itemNotes.DRAGON_SCALE: Reforge stone dropped by all dragons except Superior Dragons.
itemNotes.ENDSTONE_GEODE: New drop from mining nodes deep at the bottom of The End.
itemNotes.LUXURIOUS_SPOOL: Dropped 100% of the time from the Broodmother.
itemNotes.MIDAS_JEWEL: 1% drop from King Midas in Dungeons.
itemNotes.MOLTEN_CUBE: New Magma Boss drop, used as an early-game reforge stone.
itemNotes.NECROMANCER_BROOCH: Semi-rare drop from the first three Catacombs bosses.
itemNotes.PREMIUM_FLESH: Mostly dropped by Dungeon zombies at 1/500 to 1/1000.
itemNotes.RARE_DIAMOND: Rare drop from diamond ore in the Deep Caverns.

patches.title: [June 15] New achievements + Hyper Furnace
patches.summary: Adds new achievements and the Hyper Furnace, an instant smelter unlocked at Cobblestone collection level 8.

patches.title: SkyBlock Patch 0.7.10 - Sacks, Replenish Enchant, Shift-Clicking Mania
patches.summary: Adds Sacks for storing collection items, the Personal Compactor talisman, the Replenish enchantment, a Wool Weaver NPC, and shift-click support across menus.

itemNotes.ENCHANTMENT_REPLENISH_*: New enchant that auto-replants crops, Nether Wart and cocoa beans on hoes and axes. Costly to craft.

patches.title: [June 4] Mystical Mushroom Soup
patches.summary: Adds a stronger Mystical Mushroom Soup, since flight time is now kept when you leave and come back to your island.

itemNotes.SUPER_MAGIC_MUSHROOM_SOUP: Stronger version of the soup added. The crafting recipe is not included in the post text.

patches.title: Skyblock Patch 0.7.9 - Wardrobe, Backpack Changes + QOL
patches.summary: Patch 0.7.9 adds a Wardrobe that stores up to 18 armor sets, quick backpack swapping, and many quality-of-life fixes such as decimal bank and auction amounts and new commands.

itemNotes.ENCHANTED_ICE: Super Compactor 3000 now converts Enchanted Ice into Enchanted Packed Ice, giving a new route into that product.
itemNotes.ENCHANTED_PACKED_ICE: Can now be produced from Enchanted Ice through the Super Compactor 3000, which may add supply.

patches.title: [May 24] Small Fishing + Item Pickup Changes
patches.summary: Small fishing and pickup update: Diver set pieces now give 2% sea creature chance each while Angler pieces give 1%, plus quick crafting priority and pet and quiver fixes.

patches.title: [May 21] Protector QOL + Pet Balance + More
patches.summary: Reworks Endstone Protector drops around a Zealots Contributed score, adds crystal fragments for top damagers, and rebalances many pets. Removes the potion limit and private-island combat XP from monster kills.

itemNotes.CRYSTAL_FRAGMENT: Added to the Endstone Protector drop table for the top 5 damagers.
itemNotes.RED_ROSE: Protector poppy drops replaced by Endstone Roses, which can be collected or sold to a shop.

patches.title: [May 19] Auction House BIN + Cancels
patches.summary: Adds Buy-It-Now auctions that sell instantly and lets sellers cancel auctions that have no bids. Rebid minimums are now tiered by price, and bazaar products can no longer be auctioned.

patches.title: [May 15] Items Buyback + Repelling Candle
patches.summary: Adds the Repelling Candle to keep unwanted mobs off your island and lets NPC merchants buy back up to 10 recently sold items for an hour. Bat Firework now grants purple candies, and the Blazing Fortress scroll recipe is fixed to use dust.

itemNotes.ENCHANTED_GLOWSTONE: Blazing Fortress Travel Scroll no longer uses this as a block cost, removing that demand.
itemNotes.ENCHANTED_GLOWSTONE_DUST: Blazing Fortress Travel Scroll now correctly costs dust, adding demand for dust.

patches.title: [May 13] Fast Travel
patches.summary: Introduces Fast Travel, which warps you to the hub from any island and unlocks other islands with travel scrolls, with extra Epic scrolls for MVP+. Also adds an extra Dark Auction round and makes dragons tankier.

patches.title: SkyBlock Patch 0.7.8 - Taming Skill, Pet Items, Upgrading and More
patches.summary: Patch 0.7.8 adds the Taming skill, 16 new pets, pet items, pet candy, and an NPC system for pet sitting, trading, and selling. Unique pets now grant magic find milestones, and several pet perks are rebalanced.

patches.title: [April 3] New Bazaar Products
patches.summary: Lists more farming and misc items on the Bazaar: Hay Bales and their enchanted form, Enchanted Seeds, Sand, Mushrooms, Wet Sponge and Firework Rocket, several minion fuels, and Dragon Fragments.

itemNotes.CATALYST: Added to the Bazaar as a fuel product.
itemNotes.ENCHANTED_LAVA_BUCKET: Added to the Bazaar as a fuel product.
itemNotes.FOUL_FLESH: Added to the Bazaar as a fuel product.
itemNotes.HAMSTER_WHEEL: Added to the Bazaar as a fuel product.

patches.title: [March 12] Dark Auction Upgrade
patches.summary: Dark Auction now takes your coins when you bid and uses a queue that favors the richest players, with 330 player slots. Also fixes shop caps being bypassed and minions generating while offline.

patches.title: [March 11] Bazaar tweaks
patches.summary: Bazaar update adds API support, order-filled chat notifications, and new products such as Enchanted Raw Rabbit, Enchanted Packed Ice, Super Enchanted Eggs, and snow, mushroom and beef items. Ice minion output is doubled.

itemNotes.BROWN_MUSHROOM: Added to the Bazaar as part of the brown mushroom products.
itemNotes.ENCHANTED_BROWN_MUSHROOM: Added to the Bazaar as part of the brown mushroom products.
itemNotes.ENCHANTED_SNOW_BLOCK: Added to the Bazaar as part of the snow products.
itemNotes.HUGE_MUSHROOM_1: Added to the Bazaar as a brown mushroom derivative.
itemNotes.ICE: Ice minion output doubled, which should increase Ice supply.
itemNotes.SNOW_BALL: Added to the Bazaar as part of the snow products.
itemNotes.SNOW_BLOCK: Added to the Bazaar as part of the snow products.

patches.title: SkyBlock Patch 0.7.7 - Bazaar
patches.summary: Patch 0.7.7 introduces the Bazaar, a global market for commodities with instant buy and sell plus player buy and sell orders. Also adds a daily purchase limit on NPC shop items and three fairy souls in the hub.
